title: Fanciness over functionality- my pair anyways.
text: [[VIDEOID:fe0ded02cc8947de907313d213474717]] These are pretty, but the obvious design flaw is the extremely sharp scrolled bits that I’ve already cut my fingers on several times.  If they had curved the scroll back into itself instead of outwards it probably would have been okay, but as it is it both snags all of your fabrics & threads, but also tears your skin if you aren’t extremely careful.  So if I keep them I will either cover the sharp tips with glue, file them down, or use a soldering iron to reshape that part of the metal if I can find out if it’s safe to solder that type of metal.  The other issue I had is that the blades rub together as you can clearly see in the pics as it’s leaving marks on the metal.  As I intended to use these as embroidery snips I only need to open the scissors a tiny amount so it’s not terribly awful, but it does limit what I can do with these scissors as I had hoped to also use them for appliqué.  They are pretty & I like the overall design, but the manufacturer needs to fix the handles where the sharp parts are because it’s damaging to your expensive supplies & your body.  I have large hands for a girl which was the main reason I picked these bc I saw the handles appeared to have larger openings for the hands & they do.  As it has a screw holding the blades together I might try to adjust them to get the blades to be more fluid & not rub together & not dig into each other, but so far it just looks like the engineering is a hair off. The angles of the blades appear as though they will rub even after adjusting.  I hope not because other than what I’ve stated I like them.  They have a couple of design flaws, but I’m hoping I can work my way around them.

He informed me that the light itself is bad as the power is reaching it. How do I get it replaced since it is under warranty? The model is the: OLW 23 or 31 (it's paperwork says both numbers). title: Two easy fixes made rasp file a 5 rating for me.
text:
The rasp file needs a handle to be comfortable to use. Made one from a 4.5 inch section of rubber hose with inner diameter of 3/4 inch. To insert the rasp file in handle, with curved side of hose down on flat surface, compress with heel of palm, as rasp file is inserted into hose. When released, handle firmly grips rasp file.

Filed off edge rows of rasp teeth so they would not scratch work when using the files. Gently and slowly running the rasp file edges between thumb and index finger then index finger over the file will confirm all the burrs removed. Mine had two burrs at the corners at the ends of the flat file.

Plus being able to say "Hey Google, Dance Party" is just a blast for the kids.

title: High tolerance made my door rub when shutting, some won't even close.
text:
Ended up returning these after installing on 4 doors. EVERY single one had issues closing after installation. They seem ok when putting on until you go to close the door and if you have a reasonable new house the clearance for hinge tolerance isn't very high to create a better seal. Well if you use these overpriced hinges you won't be able to close the door afterwards.
I found another brand name, higher quality hinge for quite a bit less. DON'T Waste your money on these. This is the 4th amazon basics product I am HIGHLY DISSATISFIED with. When they first started putting out their Amazon Basics line it was a good value for the money. Now it's just another bait for amazon to make a quick buck off of terribly designed products.
Avoid at all costs!

The main negative for me was that the numbers have adhesive backs. You choose the numbers you need, and stick them on the light. It can be difficult for some people to get them on straight.

The address plaque is solar powered. There is a switch to turn the plaque on. You can choose between a warm light or a cool light.

Easy to assemble. Stays lit for hours. We were pretty impressed.

text: These are really nice aviator glasses. A little too large for me (I got the 57 mm), but my husband absolutely adores them. Perfect fit, do not rub on his nose bridge and are really good looking glasses as well. Highly recommend!

title: For the money you can't go wrong!
text: I am a single female in my sixties who has had a load of hand me down tools over the years in my garage. Some of them are rusted and just not good to use, so when I saw this set I just had to try it. It comes in a little cloth case (not super impressive from a gift giving perspective) and has a variety of 5 tools. The pliers were something I definitely needed and for my needs, this set is perfect. Highly recommend!

title: Cute and fashionable pathway lights
text: I really liked these for use on my walkway near my door. They are not super bright, but are more decorative and a means to help guide your path in the dark. They were super easy to put together and after putting them on the walkway, that night I had light where I didn't have it before. I love that I can almost have these flush to the ground so they don't interfere with my garden plants too. I love the design and the brushed nickel highlights. Highly recommend if you are looking for a decorative way to lighten your walkway.

title: Great facemasks for small children
text: These are nice disposable face masks at a reasonable price. I have two grandchildren (ages 5 and 7) who I got these to keep in my house for when they visit. They are probably not 100% the best in the market for protection against the virus, but they are a perfect size and easy to wear (which ensures they will keep them on for long periods of time). They fit well and I have heard no complaints about heat or any other issues when they wear them. I like the fact that they are individually wrapped as well as it keeps the masks clean up until use.

title: Great lighting addition to any home!
text: I have had my handyman install these in my living room tray ceiling (I wouldn't even begin to think of doing this myself). I love the way they look and I will be using them for parties and get togethers for many years to come (of course, after this pandemic). The remote control works great and makes it easy to change colors, appearances and moods at the simple touch of a button. Highly recommend!

title: Colorful and fun for night time!
text: This is super cute. I have two grandsons (ages 3 and 6) and when I set this up in their room they really loved it. Stars magically appear on the ceiling and walls and the white noise feature is a great addition (helps them sleep longer with less middle of the night wake ups). Highly recommend this to everyone. This also would make a great baby shower gift (something no one else would think of).

title: Nice adapter, does the job, but is large
text: Not overly thrilled with this travel plug. I am rating it as 4 stars as I feel there is nothing wrong with the adapter, I just don't care for it as much as others that I own. To me, it is overly big. The plug does not retreat into the unit which seems to make it even larger to try to pack. Maybe I am just picky, but I prefer the travel adapters where the are more compact.

title: Broke when trying to assemble
text: Maybe this was just the model we received but in trying to assemble the lamp one of the arms immediately cracked off and we were unable to use it.  Honestly can't review it but I will say it had a cute shade and base and would have looked great in my guess bedroom if I could have used it.

title: Great headlights that are bright and useful!
text: These are super cute and super useful. I have worn one when walking the dog during the winter months (when it gets dark so early) and this little device really lights up the road for me (and makes me visible to drivers). I also gave one to my son who jogs and rides bikes also at night and he told me that it was great to use where he is (California in the desert area where there are critters that roam at night). I also have two grandchildren that have tried these while they were camping in a backyard tent and they got such a hoot out of them. Probably the best $15 I have ever spent for safety, utility and fun!

title: Great device to set up and use!!!!! A must have!!!
text: This SUNYE Outdoor Smart Timer and Dimmer is a great device. I set it up earlier this week to use with my outdoor lights and decorations for Christmas. As an fyi, I have only one outside plug and it is situated behind a bunch of shrubbery. It is not easy to get to and I would struggle every time I would have to plug and unplug decorations. Now with a simple voice command to Alexa or even setting up the lights on a timer, I don't have to go in and out of my house to turn lights on or off. And this was super easy to set up and pair with my Alexa device. I am 60 something years old and sometimes can be technically challenged. I had no trouble at all setting this up. I highly recommend!

title: Great filter system for use in the shower!!!
text: I live in a relatively new construction home in Central/Coastal Florida. When I moved in, I was warned of having hard water and was told by neighbors that I should probably invest in a whole house water system. Of course, although that would have been great, finances just would not allow it. I started using spray on water repellent on my shower doors to help prevent spotting and so far it has been ok. When I saw this filter I thought I would try it. It was easy to install and actually works. In addition to now not having to worry about water spots in the shower any longer, I now also reap the benefit of better, filtered water for my hair and body (and no chlorine). Although I still have the hard water issues in the rest of the house, my showers (I purchased another for my second bathroom) no longer are an issue. I highly recommend this relatively inexpensive filter for every home!

title: Great indoor plant light bulb!
text: This is a perfect grow light for inside plants. I always start my vegetables and flower seedlings inside and I look for a strong, clean plant light that I can put on a timer. This is super bright but an LED variety so it is far more economical and will last longer than standard bulbs. Highly recommend!

title: Great LED light bulb for your home
text: Great LED light bulb. Clear and very bright. I love LED lights for my entire home as they are energy efficient and last far longer than traditional bulbs. If you are looking for replacement bulbs, I recommend Wiyifada bulbs, reasonably priced and good quality.

title: Easy to use and works great to light my home overnight!
text: I purchased a new home in Florida less than a year ago. It came standard with outside lights (including a few by the garage) that all manually had to be turned on to be active. As my neighborhood is not blessed with a lot of street lighting, it can be really dark at night around here. When I saw these I wasn't sure how it would work, but boy was I surprised! I love that the two lights which are on the outsides of my garage doors now go on (on their own) each night and shut off each morning. I no longer need to remember to manually put them on. 60 watts is perfect for me, not overly bright but enough to see footing to my walkway. Highly recommend for anyone who wants a sensored lighting for the perimeter of their home.

title: Great Alexa-enabled light switch!
text: Great 3 way light switch. My house definitely is Alexasized, with many devices (including vacuum and thermostat) connected. When I saw this, I thought it would be great for my bedroom and I was not disappointed. This is a great way for me to change the brightness of my 3 way bulb to help me go from low light to a reading light by just calling out a demand. I did have some difficulty setting it up, but I stuck with it and managed to get it wired and connected to Alexa. I consider myself somewhat technically-challenged so don't take my difficulty as common. I don't know what I would do without my smart devices, certainly has made my life so much easier (and fun). Highly recommend!

title: Great solar powered lights at a reasonable price!
text: For the money these lights are fantastic. I live in a fairly dimly lit community and although crime is minimal I prefer to have some sense of security at night. Being solar powered, I was able to set these up easily myself (without have to call in an electrician). These work great and I have them spaced strategically around the perimeter of my home. They are bright, but not blinding, and the solar battery charge keeps them active all night long. I highly recommend these as an added security feature for your home (at a minimal cost).

title: Great mini-flashlight that really works!
text: This is a great mini-flashlight. I use it every morning attached to my dog's leash for my pre-dawn walks. Little, compact, but packs a punch when it comes to the brightness. I have ordered another one to keep in my car's glovebox to use when I am on the road. I highly recommend this portable light for anyone who wants a small compact flashlight that is light and easy to carry anywhere.

title: Just what I was looking for!!!
text: I moved into a newly constructed house last September and have never been happy with the water pressure or the shower head that came with the house (including the fact that I upgraded). I guess the water pressure was already low (intentionally as a water saving item in the house) and the existing head was too small. Once I replaced it (and it was super easy for me to do), I was able to remove the water saving washer and now I have a great, strong, full head shower device which works wonderfully. I also ordered one for the guest bathroom as well. For the price, this is a great shower head. Highly recommend.

title: No remote but overall good attractive lighting
text: I was looking for something I could use over my kitchen cabinets and these fit the bill. Works well, I can dim the lights so they are attractive on the overnight (giving me a night-light appearance in my kitchen). There is no remote control which makes it inconvenient for me to have to turn these on and off (which is why I am deducting a star). But if not having a remote is not an issue for you, then I highly recommend this light strip to you.

title: Nice large shower head, good water pressure (finally)
text: I have to start by saying I bought a brand new construction last year in northern Florida. Part of my selections was fixtures in the kitchen and bath. I selected top notch choices, but I was not thrilled with the shower head (it was your typical smaller round head with low water pressure over all). When I saw this rainfall shower head I had to have it. I was not daring enough to do the install myself so I hired a local handyman to do it. It was easy-peasy (for him) and I loved the end result. No longer am I in a small spray area, this rainfall head gives amazing coverage and is powerful. I am thrilled with this shower head now. No complaints, just all good comments here.

title: Great lights that look perfect in my home!
text: These LED bulbs go great in my new dining room rectangular long farmhouse style chandelier. They dim perfectly and have a nice clean clear color to them and they don't get hot. They should last a long time (according to the box) and I am very happy with them. Highly recommend for anyone looking for an LED alternative light!

title: Decent fan, but I got a defective model
text: Overall, this is a nice, quiet, small sized ceiling fan. I put it out on my lanai here in Florida and it's only been out there for a few weeks, so I can't speak to how it will hold up to the humidity. I am deducting 3 stars from this review because the fan I got was defective on one of the blade frames. I couldn't screw the blade into the frame on two of the three screwholes. It was like they were stripped. Anyway, one of my blades only has one screw holding it on the frame. Not sure if anyone else had this problem. I tried using tape to secure it, but not sure if it will hold. I had my neighbor take a look at it and he told me it is defective. Anyway, I just hope, while it's running someday, the blade doesn't fly off as a projectile if it loosens. Poor workmanship for sure.

title: Fantastic Smart Plug
text: First, I have to mention I have several smart devices that work with Alexa in my house. This is my first Geeni product for same. I had no issues setting it up (unlike some other reviewers) and I can be technology impaired. This works like a gem and I keep it in my bedroom not only for me to activate the light but also for the nightlight feature. If there is a negative it's because it's not made in the USA. But outside of that, it is reasonably priced and works great.

title: Great candles for indoor or outdoor decorations, easily controlled, look great (and real)!
text: These are really great remote controlled 'candles'. I put them on my porch outside (I live in Florida and have a screened lanai). These are colorful and look like authentic candles. I love that I can control these from inside the house with the remote. I have gotten a lot of compliments since I have received them and at least one person (my sister) asked me where I got them and asked for the link. These are impressivd and look super real. Highly recommend!

title: Great holiday lighting set
text: These are a great little set of lights. Planning to use them to decorate my fireplace or my stairwell. Took them out of the box to try them out. Lot's of nice options for twinkling, well constructed and they appear that they will last several seasons. As of today these are listed for over $200. Must be a mistake as one can get something similar at Walmart for less than $20. Anyhow, for around $20, you would have a great set of lights for your tree or home decor this year at Christmas.

title: Another great Waterpik product!
text: This is a great Waterpik for your home. Beautifully designed, it ergonomically fits in your hand and has 6 modes of pulsing to help relieve pain and sore muscles. Also streams water powerfully to assist in your showering and cleanups. The best part of this was it was so easy for me to install. I had an older version in my bathroom and I was hoping that i could do this myself (without having to drag in my significant other to assist). I easily was able to replace my existing one with hardly any issues, and I am technically challenged to say the least! I love the way this looks in my shower and it makes my bath look like I gave it a makeover! This Waterpik model has a great price, too, which makes it an affordable luxury as well.

title: Great modern look, a little difficult to install for the technically-challenged woman I am!
text: I honestly love the idea of this. Modern, sleek and lasts a lot longer than typical floodlight bulbs that I use around my house. I tried to install this myself in my bedroom, and I have to admit it took me quite a while. I am not a technical person by any means and usually screwing in the lightbulb is about the extent of my capabilities, lol. However, once I was able to figure this out, the second one was an easier install. I think it also made it harder since my ceilings are relatively high and I was trying to do all this on a ladder. Next time they go out (which hopefully won't be for quite a while), I may get a handyman to do it for me. They look great though!

title: Great powerful little light and personal electrical charger!
text: Great little light to keep around for emergencies or for those who go camping. I love the fact that for the size of this, the amount of light dispersed is absolutely amazing and it will run for up to 12 hours on a single charge. To be able to charge my I-phone is just icing on the cake. I live in Florida and love that I will now be able to charge my phone during storm related power outages. I will agree with others that I am wondering about the ability to change the lithium battery once it wears down. I can't see spending almost $40 for a flashlight/charger that may only last a year or two. I need to do further research on the batter, I went to the CAT website where they discuss the product but still don't see anything where you can replace the battery. Maybe it's meant to be semi-disposable?

title: Great new technology!
text: Let me start by saying that I, personally, did not install this. I have a handy man who comes here occasionally and I had him hook it up for me. According to him, this dimmer seemed a little more complex to install than others, said there was a lot more wiring. I actually downloaded the software to my IPhone from the ITunes store and got ready for the light when he finished. I was really impressed at how easily this is to use. I even set the time for sunset and set the light to 37% so now I won't be coming home in the dark any longer! No complaints, just really impressed how easy it was for me to use and learn.

title: Great gadget, does the job for a price
text: I don't have a lot to add as to what others have said. I found this unit extremely easy and accurate to use in determining where I can successfully mount a wall television in my bedroom. I also have a Zircon wall scanning unit and in comparison, this Bosch is much easier to use and I think I can rely on it more. On the downside, it is pricey, but as a gadget for the homeowner who has everything, this truly fits the bill. Easy to use, detects through walls easily and accurately. I agree with other users. It would make more sense not using batteries in this as is, since my use for it will be sporadic and I think battery use will be wasteful. I think either an attached powerpack battery that you can plug in to charge prior to use would be more economical and far more useful in my opinion.

title: I love this power center!
text: This is a cool little gadget I bought to help give me some additional outlet space when my kids come over. I love the fact that I turned my two outlet wall unit into one of 6 and on top of it, I can charge my iPhone and iPad at the same time! Great little shelf to hold the phone (so it cannot get spilled on the countertop. This is a great little device!

title: Great cordless way to clean up around the outside!!!
text: To begin with, I have been using a leaf blower which is electric for the past 4 or so years. I hated the fact that every time I went to use it I had to set up the extension cords and I never could really complete the job due to the length of my driveway. And, yes, I often thought of buying a gas powered one, but I hate the idea of keeping gasoline in my garage at all times. In comes the 40 volt Lithium-Ion battery-powered Dewalt Brushless Blower and I have to admit I absolutely love it! First I am no longer tethered to my electrical outlet and I can move at ease anywhere I chose to use it. I also don't have t worry about storing gasoline as this runs on a battery. Right out of the box, the Dewalt delivered flawlessly. Quick, long-lasting charge, the Dewalt quickly and effortlessly did my driveway, walkway and even my patio (several hours of usage). I have no complaints about the Dewalt. It is powerful and relatively quiet, and gets the job done quickly (without needing to maneuver around a power cord). I absolutely love this!!!!

title: Beautiful lamp for a girl's room

title: Great Flexible Flashlight!
text: When I ordered this flashlight, I wasn't quite sure what to expect. I had been looking at tripod flashlights, but I didn't know which one was the best for the money. Now that I have used this 3 & 1 Stanley Tripod Flashlight, I don't think I could ever live without it! My first was for use in my garage. I had a garage door chain which was off the track. I set up the tipod and used the rotating head to shine the light on the exact spot I was working on. I honestly don't think I could have finished the job in the shaded darkness of a closed garage (even with the ceiling light on) without this Stanley. I recommend this for all women who will attempt to do many home repairs by themselves. I can see where I will be using this flashlight quite often because of it's maneuverability and flexibility!

title: Recessed lighting LED, set of 20
text: Recessed LED lights, set of 20.  We have a very small kitchen and 4 recessed lights.  Our old LED recessed lights, approximately 10 years old, began to fail and we purchased these as replacements.  We replace all LED lights in a series (like in the kitchen) at once - even if only one is failing - as in this case.  I am VERY disappointed in these.  First, they are a fraction of the weight of the old ones - quality?  I know things 'improve' with time- sometimes getting lighter in weight, but in this case - NO.  We installed them and in the process discovered they have 4 light brightness/color settings.  The lower wattage you go, the more 'yellow' the lights become.  Now for the real kicker - and kiss of death - they strobe or flicker or phase in and out - whatever phrase you want to call it.  When on the brightest setting, every 4 seconds - on the dimmest setting every 15 seconds.  I get migraines over such flickering - so they are junk to us.  I have read other reviews complaining about these since purchasing and a lot are suggesting you MUST install a 'dimmer' switch to control the flicker!  That is not an option in our kitchen as we have dual light switches.  But even if it was, I would return them.  The old ones didn't flicker. Our house is completely LED and NONE of them flicker.  So, they are being returned flat out.  BEWARE.  If you purchase these they are probably going to flicker - if that doesn't bother you, fine.  If it does, as with most folks, do not purchase these.  I cannot recommend these to anyone for any reason.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I never tried the "tack" on or screw on types for fear of harming my floor - and then we found these!  These are a really good design.  They are different than other silicone sleeve with the felt squares only at the bottom... those slip and tear the silicone, eventually coming off.  SO FAR - these have stayed in place perfectly, without slipping.  Key is that the felt square rounds UP the side of silicone sock.  Slides A LOT better across the floor as you're sitting on the chair than any of the other stick on felts.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Time will tell if these are as good as they seem to be.  We have four chairs so we used 16 tips and you get 24.  So there are replacements should they become necessary. title: silicone face cover frames
text: I just received these and haven't used them fully yet... but a couple of things.  These happen to fit my face perfectly.  I read another review that complained it created "gaps" under their eyes - I think it must have been the particular mask they were using and/or the silicone frame wasn't fitting properly.  We are all different, I think I lucked out.  I haven't decided if I will use double sided tape or tack them into my masks for "busy" use - but when I am sitting here just testing them out with my various masks and now the double masking process - the frame sits solidly in my mask and while I am not talking, it seems to be staying in place without any tape or tacking.  It may be different if you're talking a lot or moving your head a lot.  I also read a review that said the frame was too heavy and they couldn't keep their mask on... that is an ear adjustment issue I think.  I have not had that issue.  I plan to wash them on the top rack of my dishwasher as others have noted they have done this without any problems.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  All in all, these really help me to feel less claustrophobic in my mask by keep the mask away from my mouth while breathing.  Look, ultimately the whole reason to mask/double mask is to protect yourself and others from the virus. You gotta wear your masks properly.  If these don't fit your face, definitely don't use them. I personally think because they are reusable they are worth the expense and effort to see if they will work for you.  If you don't mind your mask touching your mouth, you probably don't need them.  We've got to wear them to reduce the variants and bring the pandemic to an end!  Here's to working together to get this done!

title: waterfall faucet
text:
[[VIDEOID:a9acf5d63a0f761d3938fa7867aec297]] UPDATE BELOW
I just put in a vessel type sink in my bathroom and had chosen a more spout pour faucet. The problem was the water would splash over the front edge of the sink. When we tried to reduce the pressure of the water, it wasn't enough pressure to rinse. So, I purchased this style. The waterfall effect "fans" the water so there is less of a "hose" stream of water and while we did slightly lower the pressure, the water now stays in the sink. In addition, the faucet is quite lovely. I was worried it was a bit too modern, but it looks very nice with the brushed satin texture and the oval shape that matches my vessel sink and the beveled edge mirror above it. It's actually quite a nice look. Also the faucet itself is quite weighty - I hope this equates with quality. The previous faucet was super loud too - like a jet plane taking off... this one is quite pleasant, sounds like water, not a jet plane. Those are all the pros... there were a couple of "cons" I've noticed so far... the water doesn't stop immediately... it's sort of slowly stops pouring. I didn't see any where to adjust for this so I am hoping it won't end up a dripper or leaker. The other is that the hoses that were included with faucet were WAY too short. Fortunately the hoses from the other faucet we were replacing fit. Lucky shot. Time will tell and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE: 1/13/2021 I am concerned about the slow stop on turning off the faucet. There isn't anyway to adjust the stop. In all honesty, I love the look and the feel of the faucet but I am looking at other options.

text:

2/27/2019 - full disclosure - I have been asked to reconsider my original review and have been provided another switch by the seller. Sadly, I have nothing more positive to say about the switch. One of the most disappointing points of this switch is that in order to use the switch you must remove the back plate to access the battery box. The problem I had with the first switch is the same with the second one provided. It simply will not budge. It doesn't slide... it doesn't pop off... it is solidly attached. You must 'force' the plate off, which is plastic, and of course, breaks. So you plan to use it as desk top or table top switch - you're good. However, you won't be able to attach to a wall after breaking the back panel simply to access the battery box. I had the same issues with the second one as with the first, it doesn't work more than it does as a switch. It is a toggle - so you press it over and over again - sometimes it works, sometimes it doesn't. Note: the switch was about 2ft from the receiver - well within the distance specifications. Frustrating to say the least. I really appreciate that the seller is trying to address their production issues. They have been friendly and active. I believe that they are genuinely trying to address all of these issues. I am an Amazon customer for over 25 years - carefully and honestly reviewing thousands of items. It is rare to have a seller so seemingly committed and forthwith in their communication with me. I do wish I had more positive things to say about this switch - but I think their issue is with the makers of these switches - not the seller. I anticipate they will be able to make easy changes in the production - such as not attaching the wall plate before shipping. As for the other issues - sometimes you have work out quality control as well. I thank the seller for contacting me and for seeking out my input as to what the issues are. I just wish I could have changed my review to their benefit.

title: mason jar lights
text:
These are just the lids and lights... NO JARS. I knew this going in, so I purchased my own jars and some polished rocks to use as weights - we have rambunctious ground squirrels. I also purchased, separately, "stainless steel" handles as we live on the ocean front in Oregon. The handles were a bit of trick to get on the jar - it works best if you "screw" them on, like a lid sort of. I sort of twirled the lights so they hung down as a swirl down the center of the jar and then screwed the lids onto the jars. They charge in the day, come on at dusk and mostly stay on all night long. A couple I notice don't.. but I was only hoping for a few hours - so I'm good with this. They are not really bright enough to use a path way light - but they are bright enough to be a very pretty decoration. I ordered a dozen, but went back for a third set as my very determined squirrels did manage to shatter one by knocking it off even with rocks for weights! My Mom loved them, so I let her take three of them. She has them in her window sill, inside. They work nicely there too. As long as they get sun to charge, it's good. Now, I will say, that the rings have become to rust. I haven't tried to pop out the light portion and put a new ring on, but I may try this after the summer season is over. All work. I had NO failures. Some don't last through the night, even though they have exactly the same sun exposure - but still, last for hours. I do recommend putting something in the jars for weights even if you don't have sassy squirrels like we do as they will likely stay put better. ..As I said I used polished rocks.. but you could use glass beads or marbles or shells that heavy or packaged sand (because its dry - don't get it off the beach) really anything that would provide weight and you can fit into the canning jar. All in all, I really like these lights... just wish the rings were more resistant to rust! They would make beautiful wedding decor, or other party decor or individually as gifts with special inserts (weights). My Mom adores hers. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. If I decided to try and replace the rings I will post how that went. And I hope this info was helpful to you in some way.
UPDATE 8/14/2018.... I have added some photos that might be helpful - while the outer rings have rusted... eh... they are outside.. we are oceanfront (although they would rust outdoors anywhere) - I consider the rust "patina" ... I may not attempt to replace the rings until they are not functional anymore - a couple seasons?? I DO recommend the separate purchase of the handles. They make the jars a lot easier to move around. title: Salt lamp bowl
text:
I purchased two of these for my tiny AZ home... one for the master bedroom and one for the living/dining area. I have never purchased a salt lamp before and I cannot speak to the list of possible benefits, but I am hopeful for positive results. However, having said that, the lamp is lovely. The dimmer switch is very nice. You can control the brightest easily using the dimmer switch which clearly changes the mood. The salt chunks are large and each chunk is unique in color and size and shape as you can imagine. The bowl holder is a clear acrylic type material... about 8" in diameter - just eye balling it... and about 6" tall. It came very carefully and beautifully packaged. Once you put the salt in the bowl I can image that you don't want to move them around a lot as it could scratch the bowl. I did carefully move a few pieces to places I felt were better. I have had the lamps plugged in for about 8 hours... no odors. Just a really beautiful glow. The dimmer switch is hard. You just tap it to turn it on or off and gently press to dim or brighten. There is a very nice booklet with instructions on how to change the bulb (a spare is provided) Cleaning instructions say: regularly dust salt crystals with a dry, clean cloth. Do not wash or clean with water or detergents, If not in use for a long period of time, store the lamp in a cool, dry environment, covering the crystals with a plastic bag. The lamp may naturally moisten in humid environments - saying further that if you use in a humid environment leave the lamp on for several hours to naturally dry out (I'm thinking like in a bathroom?) They also note not to place to close to electronics as the salt may draw moisture. It says if the salt crystals become moist - gently pat down with a clean dry cloth - also noting not to clean the bowl with any organic or other solvents or it may become damaged.
I would say if you're looking to purchase one of these as a gift, they are beautifully packaged and look very high end. The price is definitely higher than some of the options but not the highest. I personally chose the bowl style of salt crystal because salt may draw moisture and I wanted it contained instead of dripping off a free standing rock without containment. I do really love the soft glow. That alone is worth the purchase to me. I do really hope the claimed health benefits will be a bonus.
I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info should seem useful. I also try to answer all questions to best of my ability. Hope this helps you in your decision.
UPDATE: 2/10/2017.... I have been using both lamps 24/7 for some weeks now. Both are still working perfectly. I still believe these salt lamps are a really good buy. I've looked at so many in person that were so much more money and so much less lamp. I think one of the best parts is the dimming light. You can really adjust to comfort, for instance, in the bedroom. Still feel these lamps are really 5 star items.

Assembly of the lamp is fairly easy, but allow about 1/2 hour to put it together.  Perfect reading lamp.

title: COLORFUL AND FUN
text: Three colors of lights (red, blue and green) make up this string of lights.  You can turn on any one color, two colors at a time or all three.  They look great and there are lots of options of light combinations.  You also can have steady lights, flashing, strobe, fade and smooth (whatever smooth means).  You use a remote control to do the various settings and it works well.  The brightness controls on the remote didn't seem to do that much, but all the other color choosing buttons worked, as did the ON and OFF.  I was just slightly disappointed that there was no WHITE light choice.  I was thinking of using these for lighting model railroad buildings, but white light would have been preferable.  The colored lights will probably work reasonably well.  These are really better for parties or seasonal events.  Very pleased with them.  The only issue is that the included manual is hard to read, as some of the print is dark on dark.  As it turned out, the pictures in the manual were enough to get the lights hooked up and working.  Lots of fun playing with the different light and color combinations.

title: Very Loud, but apparently only runs for one minute
text: This is much smaller than it looks in the picture, but that's good.  It will fit just about any place.  It even comes with a dual sticky pad to attach it wherever you wish.  Also includes batteries.  The alarm is very loud and piercing, so you should be able to hear it, even if it is a little far from you.  I knocked off 1 star on my rating because the confusing English of the instruction sheet made it difficult to understand exactly how it operated.  It apparently only alarms for one minute before shutting off.  That's another reason I didn't rate it 5 stars.  I think there would be situations where 1 minute wouldn't be quite long enough.  Simple, easy to use device, that appears to work.  I tested by putting it on a wet napkin and it really started screeching quite loudly, so it doesn't take much water to set it off.  Put them any place you might get a water leak and you can be alerted before more damage is done.  Hot water tanks will eventually always leak, so I put the detector by the bottom of my tank.

title: Well made; don't generate heat like incandescent bulbs
text: The days of the old incandescent bulb are numbered.  In fact I heard that they have stopped making them (except for special purpose bulbs).  I am sure that some people don't want to buy LED bulbs because they are more expensive.  LED bulbs offer several advantages over conventional bulbs.  First of all they tend to last a lot longer (or at least are supposed to; I think that might be debatable).  Secondly, they don't generate much heat and use less electricity than incandescent bulbs.  Thirdly (and this is an opinion only), I think they tend to put out brighter, whiter light and I like the light quality much better than compact fluorescent bulbs or regular bulbs.  As to this brand, they appear to be well made and attractive.  I checked all 6 bulbs in the pack and they all worked.  The acid test is how long these will last, but since they probably won't burn out for years, I can't comment on that.  Even if they last only about as long as regular bulbs, they are probably still worth the small extra price because of the energy savings.  Also if you have inquisitive children, they won't burn themselves if they touch an LED bulb.  I have burned myself touching a regular bulb and halogen bulbs get very hot.  I have replaced some of my halogen lights with LEDs.  I am only buying LED bulbs from now on.  They make them in most sizes now for most applications.  Not sure if other sizes are available in this brand, but I just replaced two 4-foot long fluorescent tubes with LED tubes (not this brand) and I love them.  Not sure how this brand compares in prices to other brands, but they don't seem very expensive.  I think prices have come down on LED bulbs and as the older type of bulbs go away, prices may get even better.  I think you can buy these with confidence.  If you haven't used LED bulbs before, try a pack and you will never go back to other types of bulbs.

title: Bright beautiful light that beats other alternatives
text: The days of the old, hot, energy comsuming incandescent bulb are numbered.  I started switching to compact fluorescent bulbs a few years back because they were more efficient than the old incandescent bulb.  The problem with those is that the color of the light is not as good as other bulbs; also they take a little time to reach full brightness.  Also the curly shape is not always that attractive.  LED bulbs are going to eventually be replacing just about every other bulb in time.  These particular ones have a nice bright glow and put out nice light at low energy consumption.  With rising electric bills, LED bulbs are going to be more and more important.  I recently even found LED replacements for my 4 foot long florescent bulbs in several fixtures and they put out good quality light at probably less power consumption than the florescent bulbs.  Will have to use these particular bulbs for some time before I find out if they are going to last a long time, but I expect they will.  Yes, LED bulbs are more expensive, but over time will pay for themselves in lowered energy cost and longer life than standard bulbs.

title: Heavy Duty; Top Quality; Well Worth the Price
text: I am familiar with some of the lock boxes that various realtors use around my city and this is better quality and heavier duty than most I have seen.  Simple to change combination on.  Hasp is detachable if you want to mount it on a wall instead of hanging it over something.  Includes the mounting hardware for wall mounting.  The included instruction sheet is easy to follow.  This is no lightweight cheap lock box.  It should last a long time.  Has sliding cover to protect the dials.  The only thing I found lacking is that there is no information at all as to where it is made and no company address, phone or website.  I do have one concern.  The instructions suggest that you rotate the dials about once a week to keep them moving freely; I can tell you that won't happen on my lock box!  I don't know how necessary that is, but shouldn't be a problem for a frequently used lock box.

title: Nice and bright bulbs; generate no heat
text: Most of our future light bulbs will be LED because of the energy savings.  Also LED bulbs like these generate no heat.  In a cold climate, maybe it is good to have the old incandescent bulbs that give out heat, but there are better, more efficient ways to get heat than from light bulbs.  In a hot climate where I live, LED bulbs are a nice advantage and I am gradually switching to all LED bulbs.  I don't need any extra heat in the house.  The light from these seems better than compact florescent lights that were popular before LEDs came on to the scene.  My problem with compact florescent lights is that sometimes they don't seem to last much longer than incandescent bulbs and they don't give off the best color of light, plus they take time to get to full brightness.  LED bulbs, the other hand, probably will last longer, although I have gotten some of those in the past that burned out rather quickly, but not this brand.  Other LED lights have lasted a good long time and the light is much nicer.  These seem to be nice and bright and give off a good color white light.  The acid test will be how long they last, but I don't plan to come back to the review in a few months or years to let you know that they burned out.  Some bulbs last a long time.  I have some that have been in service for 20 years in daily use (although not LED).  These are attractive bulbs and appear to be well made.  If you are replacing old incandescent bulbs, I would certainly consider these.  Not sure where they are made (no indication on the package).  Most likely not in the U.S., as the English in the included "installation manual" is not perfect (but is understandable).  The "manual" is printed in 4 languages.  Of course, who needs a manual to install a light bulb?; you just screw it in.  The manual does cover common problems with LED bulbs, which is a nice to know.  It appears the company cares about their product and the quality, based on the inclusion of the manual and a short note that I found included with the bulbs.  I would buy this brand again.

title: Very attractive; high quality
text: This is a very heavy, high quality faucet that looks classy.  It seems to compare in quality to other high end faucets, some which cost two to three times what this one does.  I don't know if I could figure out how to install it myself, as there are a lot pieces.  There is an illustration to show how to assemble it, so I probably could do it in time.  Had not really planned to do it myself anyway, but to have a plumber install it.  I would recommend that unless you have done some semi-complicated plumbing, you don't try to install it yourself.  It is not quite as simple as a single lever kitchen sink faucet; this is intended for a bathroom.  You will need some simple tools and plumber's putty if you do attempt it yourself.  I gave this 5-stars just because of quality and the looks; haven't gotten it installed yet, but I suspect that it wouldn't take long for a good plumber.  If you only "dabble" with simple plumbing, plan on this taking a full day or more.  Note: includes a new popup drain too.  If you have cheaper faucets in place, this will add a lot of class to your bathroom.

title: Attractive Lamp; good quality; easy to assemble but with a couple caveats
text: Gorgeous lamp.  The switch on the lamp works to operate either of the two lights independently or both at the same time  Very easy to assemble.  You can't make a mistake on assembly, as the way the lamp is packed it is obvious.  There are four sections that you have simple screw together and then one Allen screw that you tighten to hold the top on (Allen wrench is included).  The lamp is sufficiently heavy so that it won't easily tip over; in other words, it is not a flimsy lamp.  Has a nice heavy base and sturdy column.  I almost knocked off one star on my rating due to an issue with assembly.  When you screw the sections together you have be extremely careful to line them up perfectly straight.  I didn't at first on one section and it got slightly cross-threaded and leaned slightly in one direction.  I was able to unscrew it and redo and fortunately the threads did not get damaged.  The sections fit together tightly once you line them up properly.  I did have one other minor assembly problem when putting on the shades.  There is a screw-on shade holder that you remove, put on the shade and then screw it back on.  It was on so tight that when I removed it, it actually loosened up the screw-in fixture holder that it attaches to and the fixture came out of the lamp.  I pushed it back in and screwed the retainer back in and then put on the shade.  No big deal, but when they assembled this at the factory, they must have tightened the shade holder too much on one side.  Since I got it together successfully without too much trouble and since it looks great, I am rating 5 stars, but just be away that if you get this, you have to be a little careful during assembly.

title: FUN ITEM FOR STORAGE OF SMALL TREASURES
text: This is a fun item that I would have loved as a kid.  I think once I did cut out the interior of a book to use as a hiding place.  It seems best suited for kids who want to keep small items hidden and somewhat secure.  This looks real enough to pass as a book to the casual observer.  Some reviewers complained about the plastic page edges not looking realistic, but unless you touch them, I thought they looked real enough.  I wouldn't put anything too valuable inside, as a determined person could break into it or just pick it up and walk off with it.  Also if you have someone who likes to browse through your books and they pick this up, they will discover its' secret easily, once they open the cover or try to thumb through the pages.  Seems ideal for small items that you wouldn't want someone to steal, but which don't have high value.  Good for inexpensive jewelry, coins, small collector items, etc.  It has two keys, so just be sure to keep them in separate locations in case you lose one key.  This appears to be a quality made product and is sturdy.  Seems like a great fun gift item for kids or adults.

title: Simple, Attractive and Very Useful
text: With an increasing number of devices that use USB cables to charge up, it is easy to run out of outlets and this outlet/charger makes a lot of sense.  This couldn't be any easier to use; just plug it in.  It has adequate space for a fat 3-prong grounded plug that won't interfere with the USB jack.  I didn't care for the blue "pilot" light that it has when it is plugged in, but it does show you that it is working.  Also I wasn't sure how truly useful this would be for me, as many of my devices come with recharging cords that have standard outlet prongs on one end and USB to plug into my device.  If I wanted to use this, I would have to abandon the original charger and use a regular USB cable.  Since the small end of USB cables can vary from device to device (there are at least 3 different sizes that I know of and maybe more), that might mean buying a USB cable that would specifically plug into my device, in order to use the USB port on this charger.

title: Low heat output compared to regular bulbs; look attractive
text: Recently I replaced all the bulbs in my chandelier in our dining room with this kind of LED bulbs, but I didn't buy any spare bulbs, so I ordered these so I would have some replacements if any of them quit working.  Why replace regular bulbs with LED?  Two reasons.  The first is that they are so much more efficient, so don't consume nearly as much power as regular bulbs.  The second big reason for me was heat.  Regular bulbs in a big chandelier put out a lot of heat.  In a cold climate you might like that, but I live in Arizona and in summer the chandelier was putting out too much heat, so we were often uncomfortable sitting under it.  We eat and play cards under that light, so we are spending a lot of time there.  What a difference after I changed to LED bulbs.  I am gradually changing all the bulbs in my house to those that consume less energy and hope to eventually see a difference on my electric bill.  These are nice looking bulbs, just about as good looking as any regular chandelier bulbs.  Since these are low wattage, you probably would only want to use them in a multi-bulb fixture.  The price is very reasonable too, even though expensive compared to regular bulbs.

title: WONDERFUL BIDET; VERY EASY INSTALLATION; ALL PARTS INCLUDED
text:
This fits my Kohler elongated toilet perfectly. This will not fit a standard toilet, so make sure you have an elongated toilet before you order it.
Installation was amazingly simple. All I had to do was use a screwdriver to remove my old toilet seat. Then you just install an adapter with two included screws and nuts. Then the Kohler bidet with toilet seat and cover just snaps into place. It snaps in very easily. Also it removes easily with a push button down on the side. Of course once you have the water line hooked to the bidet you can't really remove it unless you unhook the line. The water connections are very easy and I was able to get them all tight enough just with my hands. No wrench needed. You don't want to overtighten the connections. The worst problem I had was getting the included feed line attached to the bidet. You are fighting against a filter that fits into the line and it is far too easy to cross thread it. The first time I had it on crooked and it popped off. Fortunately I was able to find this out before I turned the water back on. Everything is included that you need and I have never had an easier plumbing installation. Even if you are a complete dummy, I think you can manage this. One big precaution. Make sure your shutoff valve works. Older ones may leak and it's nice if you don't have to turn off the water for the whole house. After you turn off the water either by the shutoff or for the whole house, flush the toilet; then just disconnect the feed line to the toilet and replace it with a 3-way "T" that is included. The feed line from the wall goes in the other end and the bidet feed hooks to the side of the "T" connector. The bidet operates nicely. You just press down on the handle and turn it to get the desired pressure. How far you press down controls the direction of the stream. It worked well, but took me a bit to figure out that you push down on the handle and that you don't pull it upwards. Someone unfamiliar with the way it operates could probably easily break it if they yank up on the handle. It looks durable, but I have my doubts about how much you could pull up on the handle without breaking it. Human nature is to pull up, so this might be a slight usability flaw in the design. Probably will be important to let guests know how to use it. It's much nicer than those bidets where you have to turn a dial. The seat looks very nice and classy, but is very light and made of plastic, so not sure of long term durability. Since this contains both seat and cover too, you probably will want to wait until your toilet seat and cover need replacing before you get this. Other bidets on the market are add-ons to existing seats, but I much prefer this. My only disappointment with this is that we wanted to use it with a raised toilet seat, but it will not work with that because the raised seat fits inside the toilet bowl and the bidet portion of this is in the way.

title: Very Cool and Fun Device, but has a few issues
text:
I gave this 4 stars in my rating because for what it does, it works well. I did have issues with it. Don't buy one unless you have an Android phone to set it up. I bought a different device a year or so back that I could never use because I didn't have a phone at that time to set it up. The setup on this is effortless, but the switch didn't work at first on my rocker switches. There are two different adapters that you can use if it does not quite turn on and off the switch. At first I used the thicker adapter and it was too thick, so used the thinner one and that did the trick. You have to be careful positioning this as one of the first times I used it, it pushed itself off and fell to the floor. The magnets are strong and attached it well, but the mechanism in the back can push the switch away from your switch underneath and can even dislodge as mine did. After I got the correct spacer/adapter on it, this didn't seem to be an issue. I wasn't thrilled that this used 2 AA batteries, but given the fact that it is wireless, there is no other way it could get power to run the little motor in it to change the switch positions. It is a little bigger than your switch, so you can't use two side by side. My biggest disappointment was that there is no motion sensor in the switch, so it's fully dependent on your cell phone or manual operation. Manual operation is pointless, as you can just use your regular switch without this device over it. It's a very cool thing to be able to control a switch with your phone. You can of course use it on any switches (such as for fans) and not just lights.
If you want remote or timer control of lights, this is just the thing if you don't want to mess with wiring. I have some timer switches, but they are hard to set because you have to look at a very tiny display and they had to be wired into the switch socket. At least you can program this through your phone. Just keep in mind you are always dependent on the phone for operation of this switch remotely or to set up programming. Not quite as versatile as it could be and I think the price is a little on the high side. Very fun device, but with somewhat limited use. Would be good for programming outside lights to come on at a certain time, if controlled by a switch in your house.

title: GREAT LIGHT, BUT RANGE NOT THAT FAR IN A HALLWAY
text: Very attractive light and very bright.  It says it can sense movement up to 25 feet away, but I put it at the end of a long hallway and it didn't sense movement until I got about a couple of feet from it.  That caused me to walk a good portion of the hallway in the dark until I had just about reached the light.  Probably the range is better in a larger room, as the sensor seems be aimed out toward the front of the light, with only a few feet on the sides.  This did turn out to be ideal for my garage.  There is an outlet just outside my garage door and by the time I opened the door to the garage from the house and stepped into the garage, the light was on.  It will save me from having to use my overhead garage lights, which are usually overkill, since they light up both parts of a 4-car garage.  Often I just step into the garage momentarily and this going to work really well for me.  It stays on 90 seconds, which is a good long time.  If it does go off before you want it to,  all you have to do is move again in the vicinity of the light.  I may get some more of these, as they no doubt save electricity, especially in a dark area where you might be using night lights that sense darkness and are on a lot of the time or all the time.  This is a 5-star product, but I knocked off one star for the range problem, although it does say "up to" 25 feet, which means that sometimes it won't work that far, of course.

title: Decent filter, requires careful use
text:
This is the only filter I've ever owned, and I only have one minor gripe with it. As to the filtration quality and longevity of the filters, it is a very good filter. I would rate it 5/5 for filtration and filter life.

However, I've owned two of these now, and both have not had working indicator lights. The first one worked for several months since I had bought it, but one time while changing the filter, it just stopped working. I think this may have been my fault, and I'll explain why in a moment.

The second one I bought to replace the first. I did this just so I could have a working indicator light. I'd rather not use my taste buds and gamble my health on determining whether it's still working or not. Anyway, the second one also seems to be working good; however, the indicator light has not lit up a single time yet since I've installed it.

So, when changing filters, one minor detail is VERY important to keep the indicator light working (I think this is how I broke mine). When you remove the old filter, WAIT at least 30 seconds for the indicator sensor to 'reset' BEFORE putting the new filter in. If you ignore this detail, the indicator light will likely stop working, or not work correctly. Again, it needs about 30 seconds to notice the filter is being replaced, and reset itself.

One thing to keep in mind is that this filter requires careful use. Because the white coated model comes with plastic faucet adapters, these are particularly prone to spring leaks and break if not used properly. Proper use requires careful switching of the filter mode (no filter, no filter spray, or filter). As some of the other reviews have stated, it's not designed to be switched modes while water is running, nor to filter hot water (as the manual indicates). These are important details and if ignored, your filter WILL break. Also when switching modes hold the entire thing steady as not to loosen or tighten the adapter or filter base. Again, a little precaution and your filter will continue to work just fine. You don't yank a power plug out of the wall - there's no reason to treat your filter with any less care.

title: A lovely accent lamp
text:
I used this iron scrollwork table lamp as an accent lamp on top of a CD rack. At only 18.5 inches high, it's the perfect size for an entryway, piano, bookcase or CD tower, wherever you could use a little extra light (it takes one 60W bulb).

The finishing on the scrollwork was perfectly smooth (no jagged edges or spurs) and the finish even on my particular lamp, and the lampshade is of a good quality as well (heavy fabric and good finishing on the seams). Assembly was fairly easy; you have to pull the cord through the base, which was a little harder to do than other lamps I've purchased.

The one feature I wasn't crazy about was that it has a push-button switch; I prefer lamps that have the on-off switch on the cord, but that wasn't a deal-breaker as I have it tied into a light switch, so I'm not constantly turning it on and off (I recently replaced a three-way socket on another lamp I own, and based on the feel of this particular push-button mechanism, I'm not sure how long the switch would last with heavy use).

Verdict: for the price, this is an excellent little lamp that will dress up wherever you choose to put it.

I did appreciate that batteries are included because each flashlight requires 2 AAA batteries. I put one in each bedroom and the rest went into glove boxes.

The light looks great and is very cool. There is an adhesive strip on the back. My daughter wanted this for her apartment so she's looking into other ways to mount it that don't damage the walls. The rope flexes well so you can make shapes or even words.

title: Snug
text: My husband and son both wear safety ear muffs when doing yard work. These were a little snug on both of them, but one of them has been wearing them in spite of that. I'm not sure if my son is using these or my husband as I got 2 similar pairs (different brands) around the same time so they could both have their own set. The consensus is that it does eliminate nearly all of the background noise. It allows them to listen to their own music or podcasts while mowing.

title: Great Dividers!
text: My daughter loves it when her dresser drawers are all organized. I ordered these dividers for her smaller top drawer. It's perfect and is just what she needed! It's easy to use. The slots hold socks really well. It makes it much easier to find what she's looking for!

title: Snug Fit
text: My son asked for a pair of noise cancelling ear muffs for when he mows the lawn. He wears ear buds and wanted something to block the noise so he could hear his podcasts. These are a snug fit. His head is pretty big. He wishes they were just a teeny bit larger and that there was a little more space in the ear cup so they're not pressing directly onto his ear buds. He says they do help and have made the task of mowing better.

title: Lots of Different Shapes & Sizes
text: We have been installing hardwood flooring in our house this spring. We quickly went through one small pack of felt squares that we picked up at the hardware store. This set of over 300 pieces is definitely a better value than we paid for the smaller set at the hardware store!

text: My daughter is in college. She is studying wildlife biology, so this looks just like a real book that she might have. It will allow her to hide a small cache of items if needed. The faux book is sturdy and realistic. Of course, it's not foolproof and if someone was motivated, I think they could easily break into it with a hammer or other tool. But it can give peace of mind.

title: Good Masks
text: These are good masks. They are comfortable to wear. The elastic ear straps are securely attached and I haven't had any issues with them coming off. I find these easy to breathe in while wearing. The assortment of colors is good.

title: Great!

text: My daughter needed a floor lamp for her apartment. This one has a variety of lighting options. It was pretty easy to set up. The directions were decent. It doesn't take up a lot of space. So far, so good!

text: This is a nice flashlight. I love that it's rechargeable and doesn't require disposable batteries! The charge lasts a really long time. We left it on one day to see how long it would take before it lost its brightness. After several hours, it was still going strong. Though it was very warm to the touch. In reality, we probably wouldn't keep it turned on for that long at a time. As far as the size, it's a little larger than compact flashlights, but it's not a huge torch size one either.

title: Nice Quality Lamp
text: This lamp is such a nice quality. Not only is it beautiful, but it's sturdy and stable too. Set up was straight forward. Directions were clear. I love that it has a foot switch. Our Christmas tree has that and we loved it! I am very happy with this new light!

This has done the job. I would say it's pretty comparable to other brands of similar stuff. It's not any better or worse than the others. It dries pretty quickly. It's easy to sand. So far, so good!

Of course, before doing that you do need to build the lamp pole together but that just screws together easily. The whole thing was quick to put together. Plus, the light bulb is included!

This set has individually wrapped masks in a great assorted of colors. They look like ombre or tye-dye designs. They have the nose bridge piece which is helpful. I still get a little fogging up on my glasses, but it's not too bad.

They are a little loose and we have discussed using something to tighten them up at the top so they don't fall off. She could easily use a velcro strap and wrap it around at the top just to hold them up while using them. The gloves are sturdy and durable as far as she can tell. I am happy that she has some protection from bites and scratches.

My husband thought it might be helpful if the button that you press to activate it was lit up. In the dark, it's hard to see. text: I like having solar lights out in my backyard. I put this one on a shepherd's hook in the flower bed around the patio. It has a very sturdy rope hanger. When I first opened it, it came partially charged and I was able to use it right away. I did have to unwind and arrange the fairy lights that go inside the ball. It doesn't offer a whole lot of light, but  I am pleased with how it looks with the lights it does have.

title: Sturdy!
text: I prefer metal rulers over plastic ones. They're much sturdier. This one has clear and easy to read numbers. There are measurements on both sides. There are 5 rulers in this set. Two of them are 12 inch sized and the others are 6 inches. With so many, it will be difficult to misplace them!

title: Bright Light!
text: I like the shape of this light. It wasn't as quick an install as I had expected. We had a ceiling fan that wasn't working any more. It's a room with poor lighting so I thought good lighting was more important than a working fan. My husband did require my help holding it while he screwed it in to place. It does provide improved lighting in the room.

title: Complete Set of Tools
text: My daughter is moving into her first apartment in a couple of weeks. I thought a tool set would be a helpful gift for her. This is a complete set of tools. The quality of the tools is pretty good and better than I expected from a set like this. The hammer is just as nice as my husband's name brand one. The tool case opens out flat so you can see everything. While I do like the pink color, is it really necessary? It isn't labeled as a tool kit for women, but the pink kind of implies that it is. We're trying to close the gender gap not enlarge it!

title: Safe Cutting Tool
text: My husband loves Slice cutting tools. I like that they're safer to use. This one perplexed me. I couldn't figure out how to use it. My husband picked it up and used it right away without any difficulties. He really likes it and I'm sort of "meh". I split the difference and give it 4 stars. I'll probably continue to use one of our other Slice cutters, but this one does work.

title: Secret Safe!
text: My son has expressed interest in having some kind of security safe thing to store some of his valuable trading cards. This faux book is just the trick. It pretty much looks like a real book, but if you touch it or look at the pages closely, you can see that it's not. It does blend in well with other books. It looks like it could be broken so it's not foolproof, but it does keep items hidden.

title: Nice Looking
text: This pair of lamps is nice looking. You do have to put together the lamp shades. They come rolled up and you have to attach them to the wire frame. They don't look quite as nice as pre-made shades, but they're not bad. It's definitely easier for packing them in pieces rather than fully assembled. The touch function works well and is easy to use. The lamps also have USB ports for charging. The best thing is that the light bulbs are included!

title: Nice Lamps
text: I ordered these lamps to replace some 20 year old ones in the living room. I like the shape of the lamp base. The lamp shades require some assembly. They don't look as nice as pre-shaped/ready to go lamp shades, but they are okay. I do like the addition of the USB port.

title: Easy to Assemble!
text: When ordering a lamp sight unseen, I often wonder if it's going to be a good one or not. I have gotten a few that weren't nice enough for me to use in my living room, but okay for the kids' room or basement. Well, this one is a nice one. It was easy to assemble. It's sturdy, too. The lamp shade is good and not papery thin. I've had several lamp shades that I've had to put together and this one is a whole unit. Best part of the lamp is that it comes with light bulb! I am very pleased with this lamp!

title: Easy to Install
text: We actually ordered this for the inside of the house, not outdoors. The basement stairway is always so dark and we've had challenges finding something that we liked that provided a lot of light. It was easy to install. It doesn't look bad where we put it. It does make it so much easier to see when going up or down the stairs.

title: Works Great!
text: Over the past few years, we have replaced more than half of our light bulbs with smart ones. We have some other GE ones, so we've already downloaded the app, which was nice. Many of ours are different brands and they all use a different app! I needed 3 bulbs for the ceiling fan in my bedroom. So in addition to this 2 pack, I purchased a single bulb as well. These are slightly brighter than the bulbs we replaced. It gives a good white light which I like. The brightness can be adjusted according to your preference. I am very pleased with these.

title: Comfortable to Wear
text: I ordered these black masks for my husband. He likes this style and prefers black ones. These are a small fit. They do fit his face, but if he yawns or opens his mouth wide, it doesn't completely cover his mouth area. These would work better on a smaller face. They are comfortable to wear and the fabric is fairly soft.

title: Hefty
text: This is a hefty multi-tool. It's sturdy and solid feeling. I found it very difficult to get most of the items out and so did my husband. He ended up using another multi-tool to help with the parts that were the most challenging. Hopefully, it will get easier with use. There's a good assortment of tools.

title: This is Great!
text: The door of my mailbox doesn't stay shut most of the time. It's so frustrating. So when I saw this, I had to give it a try. It fits my standard sized mailbox perfectly! We removed the original door first. Then this one is inserted into the body of the mailbox. It kind of snaps into place. Once it's in there, it stays put. You could remove it be squeezing the inner sides, but unless you do that, it's not going any where. The door is magnetic, so it closes easily and stays closed! It's not difficult to open at all. I feel so much better knowing that my mailbox is staying closed! The only negative thing I have to say is that it's so nice and shiny, that now I have to repaint the rest of the mailbox so it looks better!

title: Provides Great Lighting in the Garage
text: I wish I knew about these lights years ago! The garage is never well lit enough. Now that we have installed this, the difference is amazing! This garage light arrived in a small box. I didn't look at the measurements beforehand. It looked like a ceiling fan, so that's what I was expecting. No, it's not as big as a ceiling fan. But that's okay. It provides a huge amount of light that the size doesn't matter. Assembly was really easy. My husband walked out into the garage and came back just a few minutes later. I didn't even know he had installed it. I thought he was just examining the space and planning his course of action.  You do have to attach the panels, but once that's done, it's just like screwing a light bulb. I am excited that I can see things so much better in the garage!

title: Fun!
text: I've seen these kinds of lights available for a while, but didn't know what they were like in person. It wasn't exactly what I was expecting it to be, but it is pretty neat. This light has a base and 2 acrylic shapes. You insert one of the shapes into the base and then the LED lights light up the acrylic piece with the details of the millenium falcoln (or baby Yoda depending on which one you have in place). It can work on batteries or USB charger. My husband has this set up in his home office. This light would be great for any Star Wars fan!

title: Cute!
text: This butterfly solar garden decoration is very cute! It's metal and sturdy. The light isn't very bright, but it's fine for decoration. It's easy to stake into the ground. It charges adequately. It is a fun addition to my patio area.

title: Pretty Lights
text: My husband and I like decorating our back yard with solar powered lights. I like the uniqueness of these. They are like little trees. It does require that you spread and arrange the branches. Once they are charged, they do give up a decent light. I have both of them fairly close to one another. One seems to be brighter than the other. We've had to readjust the position of the solar panels and that seems to help. We've had some windy days lately and we have not noticed any damage to them.

title: Great for Outdoors!
text: Because of the pandemic, we started spending a lot more time out on the patio. My husband and I would invite one other couple over to hang out there where we could be in the fresh air. Since we're spending more time out there, we have started decorating it. We had one large bush that had some similar solar powered fairy lights. It looks so magical! We wanted to do more decorating with fairy lights! This strand is is easy to use. The solar feature works as expected. The lights have different patterns you can use for the flashing or twinkling. Once the sun goes down, they stay lit for at least a few hours, more or less depending on the amount of sunlight they've gotten. We are happy with these new lights so far.

title: Decent Tape Measure
text: My husband wanted a tape measure to keep in his car for those unplanned trips to the hardware store when he forgot to bring one with him. This is now that tape measure. It's a decent one, but there are better ones out there. It does do the job. It has the lock feature which is pretty important to him. The numbers are clear and easy to read. It does only measure in inches whereas his primary tape measure also has metric measurements. It has a belt clip. The case of it is sturdy. Overall, it's a good tape measure.

title: Works Well So Far
text: We have replaced many of our light bulbs with smart ones so we can control them with the Google Home. This set of 3 bulbs is nice because one app is hosting 3 bulbs. We have several different apps to control our home. Luckily, we can use the Google Home for most everything, but they still require the use of an app, The colors are fun to change. The bulbs produce a good amount of light. They work well so far!

title: Cute Water Bottle
text: I ordered this water bottle for myself. I really like the motivational markers that encourage you to drink at set times. The flower design is pretty, but the wording isn't really child appropriate. "Suck it Up Buttercup and drink your effing water" is not something that I would want my young child to have. My youngest is now in college and that would be fine now, but these bottles are geared toward children. The water bottle has as straw which can be locked down. There's a handle on the bottle. It feels sturdy. I do like it, but I think it's not really child friendly.

title: Bright Purple Color!
text: These children's disposable face masks are a bright purple color. They are soft and sturdy for a face mask. The ear straps are comfortable. They have the nose bridge wire pieces that are helpful. They are a good quality face mask.

title: Fun Lights
text: We have recently put similar LED lights on the back of 2 other TV's in the house. My college age son wanted them in his part of the house, too. These have a good adhesive. They were easy to set up. Remote control works well. The finished results are awesome!

title: Pink Desk Lamp
text: The lighting in my home office has been pretty poor lately. I didn't realize just how bad it was until I got a new lamp! Now I'm wondering how I got by with so little light for so long! I love that this lamp is pink, my favorite color! You can fold it down if you're not using it. It's easy to turn on and off. The wireless charging is a bonus! If you're needing a good desk lamp, this is a good choice!

title: Works Well
text: The overhead light in my home office doesn't provide great lighting. I love a well lit room, so I have been looking for a good lamp. This lamp works well. The neck flexes so I can adjust the angle as needed. It also works well for video conferencing. The remote control is convenient to use. The lamp does require some assembly, but I was able to put it together in just a few minutes.

title: Cool Lights!
text: We added similar lights to our living room TV and we wanted to do the same with TV in the master bedroom.
