We were able to put these on the back of the wall mounted TV without taking the TV down. The adhesive is good and we haven't had any pieces fall down. It does require a power brick but we have several around so that wasn't a problem. The remote works well with the unit. These are cool lights and really make TV watching better!

title: Gorgeous!
text: As soon as this arrived, I set it out on the patio so it could start charging. I didn't get back to it for a few days and when I did, I was disappointed because it wasn't lit. I thought maybe there was plastic over the solar panel, but I couldn't find any film or plastic over it. I went back inside and read the product description and saw that it says that the lamp has to be turned on. So I went back outside and for the life of me I couldn't find the switch. Eventually I discovered that the lid portion that holds the solar panel can come out. There's nothing to grip onto to get it out, but eventually, I was able to get it off. Then when you flip that over, there's a switch. Once I moved it to on, it lit up. The shadow that is cast from the designs are gorgeous! It really is a pretty lantern!

title: Looks Cool
text: For the most part, we couldn't tell the difference between this and just LED strips that are not geared for TV. We had no trouble attaching this to the TV. The adhesive strips are very good. The unit comes with a USB cable so we expected to be able to plug it into a USB plug adapter. But when doing that, the lights only show red and are very dim. We read the directions again and it shows a picture of a wall wart (AC Adapter) with a round plug not USB. It also mentions that it requires 12 volts whereas a USB outputs 5 volts which is why it didn't work. We happened to have an extra 12 volt AC adapter with a round connector (center positive) and that worked perfectly. Now our TV in the living room is at an angle. So the light reflected unevenly behind the TV. That's something to consider when putting one on your TV. If it had been flat against the wall, it would look better.

title: Nice Lamp
text: My 19 year old daughter recently updated some of the furniture and accessories in her bedroom. She wanted a more grown up feel to it. In doing so, she needed a new lamp for her night stand. This one is very nice looking. It's a little shorter than we expected, but that's on us because we didn't read the measurements. It works as it should. It does a nice job of updating her room.

title: Just What We Needed
text: We have a hot tub out on the patio. We usually leave our towels and robes on the table which is about 6 feet away from the hot tub. Now that it's cold out, we have been pulling the stools nearer to the hot tub so we wouldn't have to walk as far when we're getting out. Now this towel rack sits directly next to the hot tub so we can reach our towels immediately and the stools can stay at the table. The rack was easy to assemble. It's very sturdy. There are 3 racks for towels and a place for shoes or other items. We have been hanging the towels on the rack and then draping our robes over the top, to the side. I am very pleased with it!

title: Sets Up Easily
text: I've been reorganizing my home office and I wanted some storage boxes for items that I can put on my shelving unit. These work well. They're sturdy enough for light weight items. I think if I were to store heavy items in it and then carried it around, the box would break.  They set up easily. They definitely help make my room looks less cluttered.

title: Double the Looks!
text: These masks are reversible, so you have double the looks! Pretty nifty! The masks are 2 layers. There's no filter pocket. The elastic straps are adjustable. They have the wire nose bridge piece. I have a large face and these fit okay. I do wonder if they'll fit as well after I wash them. Several that I own have become too small. Luckily, if they do shrink, my daughter can use them.

title: Nice Lights
text: I ordered these lights specifically for our deck stairs, but my husband didn't want to put them on the steps. He was afraid that someone would step on them causing them to crack and break since they're made from plastic. So instead, we put them on the stair rail. They work well. The solar panel charges during the day and then they are lit up at night for as long as we need in the evening.

title: Works Just Like a Ballpoint Pen!
text: We like Slice cutters. We use them to open all of our boxes. This one is shaped like a pen and works just like one, too. I tried it on some boxes. It did an okay job, but not great. It barely cut through the tape. I was breaking the boxes down for recycling and the tape was paper as opposed to regular tape. My husband has been using it for other purposes and he has been pleased.

title: Nice Quality
text: We've been working on our lower patio to make it look nicer. We're spending a lot more time out there because of Covid. This lantern is so nice. It helps to make our patio area look homey. The candle flickers and looks very realistic. It charges during the day and when it's dark, it turns on and provides a decent amount of light. I am very impressed with how nice it is.

title: Functions Well
text: This Beyond by Black + Decker rotary tool is very convenient since it is cordless. It uses a USB cable to charge, but it does not come with a power brick. Fortunately that's not a big problem. The unit functions well and as expected. It comes with a bunch of accessories and a storage box. It is comparable to other rotary tools in the same price range. The LED light is useful. The speeds are easy to control. Overall, we're pleased with it.

title: Reinforced
text: We recently lost a tree and lots of limbs in a storm and while helping my husband with the cleanup, I noticed our tarp had seen better days. It was starting to get holes and fray at the edges. This one is pretty good and seems comparable to above average quality ones. It is reinforced at the corners. The edges are nicely done, too. It's not top of the line, but definitely better than average.

title: Great Output of Light
text: Last week we lost power for 36 hours. We live in the suburbs and have never had a power outage for that long  before and we were ill prepared. I ordered these after our power was restored and we wanted to be prepared for the next time something like that happened. These lanterns have a great output of light. You can use it like a large flashlight or extend it so it becomes a small lantern. There is a hook for hanging, a handle that can be removed, and magnets for putting it the refrigerator or car. It comes with batteries, too. We're going to be better prepared for the next time.

title: Fun Colored Lights
text: I love fairy lights! They're so dainty and cute. I usually get warm white ones, but for Christmas, I thought it would be fun to have colored ones outside. This comes with 2 strands. They're not super long, but my plans are to have both of them around one small tree that we have in our front yard. We've been playing with them on the deck until December. The copper wire bends easily. The solar panels charge adequately. The remote allows you to change various settings easily. Overall, these are perfect for our decorating!

title: Great Kit!
text: My 22 year old son still lives at home. He's finishing college and will be out on his own soon. My husband and I thought it would be useful for him to have some of his own tools when that day arrives. This is a good set of screwdrivers. There are 2 flathead and 2 Phillips head screwdrivers. In addition, there are magnetic tips and a base for more sizes. There are also some hex keys (I think). The tools are sturdy and comfortable to grip. It's really perfect for someone who is just starting out on his or her own.

title: Cute Little Lights
text: These are cute little lights. The size is good for hanging in a small tree or bush. They come with a hanging clip. You do have to put them together. The fairy lights are bright and dainty. You have to unwind them and then arrange them inside the lantern. The on/off switch is on the bottom of the solar panel. The solar panel is the lid of the lantern. So if you want to turn it off, you have to completely remove the lid. I found that to be a little annoying. The lights don't light up if there is another light source nearby. Overall, these are cute and add some decoration to our patio area.

title: Dainty Fairy Lights
text: We've been working on making over our patio space. These fairy lights are perfect for adding some additional light. We have larger, electric patio lights, so I needed these to be in the same warm white color, which these are. The solar feature allows us to use these farther from the outlet and gives us more options. It didn't take too long for these to be initially charged. There are a few different modes such as flashing, solid, etc. I do recommend unrolling the strand out in the yard or some other large space before hanging them. We did not and it was a pain! The copper wire strands are used to secure itself in the roll position, so when we got to the middle of the strand, it was almost like it was tangled up and we had to carefully unwind it and pull it through itself. It would have gone much smoother if we weren't in the middle of hanging them up! Overall, these are cute, dainty fairy lights and I love how they look!

title: Nice Masks
text: I have purchased a lot of face masks over the last few months. These are the thickest ones that I have seen. They are very comfortable to wear. I think I will like them more in the cooler season. I am fortunate that I work at home and don't need to go out very often, so I don't have to wear them for long periods of time. These may be a little difficult to breathe in for longer time lengths. For my short trips to the store, it's been okay. The wire nose bridge pieces are wonderful! Probably the best that I have had in my masks. These mold well to the sides of my nose and truly allow me to wear my glasses without fogging up. A lot of masks have the wire pieces, but they don't stay molded well and still cause foggy glasses. These don't! The ear straps are comfortable and adjustable. I do wish they offered these in pretty colors rather than just the limited neutral ones.

title: Lightweight
text: These face masks are light weight and breathable! The patterns are cute and all blue themed. They are made well. These do not have filter pockets or nose bridge wire. The ear straps are adjustable. They are all double layered. Two of the masks are lined with white fabric while the other two have the exact same fabric inside. Overall, they are good masks.

title: 60 Filters!
text: Several of our masks have the spot for these filters, so this set of 60 should last a while. They add an extra layer of protection. These are similar to other filters that I have purchased in quality, size and shape.

title: Great Fit!
text: These masks have a great fit around the face. The material is soft and there are 2 layers. There's a pocket for a filter if you use them. There's a metal strip at the bridge of the nose to help prevent fogging of the glasses. There are also the little pieces on the elastic ear straps to adjust them as needed. I wish there were more prints or colors to choose from!

title: I Like the Masks!
text: I ordered this set primarily for the masks. I personally have upped my game regarding hand washing so I don't think I will get much use out of the gloves. They are comfortable though and the fit is good. They are stretchy and fairly light weight. I really like the masks. The masks are double layer cotton fabric. They have the nose bridge piece and the silicone pieces on the elastic to adjust the fit of the mask.

title: Great Idea!
text: I have seen several variations of these no touch door openers online and was excited to give it a try. This is a 4 pack of openers, with each one a different color. They are a little larger and thicker than I expected. I have added one to my key chain, but it adds more bulk than I want. I need to pare down what I am carrying around these days. I think I will put this on a lanyard with some hand sanitizer and keep those together. The openers are sturdy and easy to use. They also have stylus tips for using on ATM buttons and similar items. Since there are 4 of these, I was able to share them with my family. In addition to the 4 openers, there are extra stylus tips and a couple of retractable key rings.

title: Very Cute!
text: My 19 year old daughter squealed when she saw this cow print face mask! It's very cute. The mask is made well. The elastic straps can be adjusted easily for a better fit. It has the metal nose bridge. There's a pocket for a filter. It's thick enough to do a good job.

title: Lots of Spray Options
text: I recently decided that I wanted to change to this type of shower head. I have never liked this style before, but it seemed like it would be helpful when cleaning the shower to be able to direct the water where I wanted it to go. It was very easy for my husband to install. We had it up for a couple of days and I was not happy with it. The water pressure was so low on it that I was having to take longer showers to be able to completely rinse out my hair. We tried all the different spray setting options, but none of them increased the water pressure. I was about to ask my husband to change back to our original shower head, when my husband read some other reviews for similar shower heads online and found it to be a common problem. The consensus from the other customers was to remove the flow regulator. We did that and the water pressure was restored to what we consider to be normal. Our showers are much quicker again.  There are lots of different spray options available to choose from. I like that you can use the handle spray but still have it spraying from the head. This would have been very helpful earlier in the summer when we were fostering a dog who liked to get muddy! So while it was a rough start, we now are quite happy with our new shower head.

title: Good Value
text: These air filters are a good value. They are comparable to other store brand filters that we have purchased. They work as expected.

title: Perfect Fit!
text: Recently I was cleaning off the patio with our Black & Decker leaf blower. The battery lasted a few minutes before it started to reduce power by more than half. I complained to my husband and he said it was the battery and that he needed to order a new one. Not long afterwards, I found these. They are a perfect fit and so far, they work quite well. This is a 2 pack of batteries so you can potentially have enough battery power to do a lot of chores. The leaf blower is the only Black & Decker tool that he has that uses, but our son has a drill and it uses the same battery. It arrived charged and we were immediately able to start using it. It provides plenty of power and lasts much longer than the old original one we have. Time will tell as to how long it is before the performance of it starts to decline, but for now, we are more than pleased.

title: Fits
text: We have 3 separate units and use 2 different sized filters. This one fits the unit it was intended for. It seems to be comparable to other budget friendly filters.

title: Great Set!
text: I have a 22 year old son who is still in college. But hopefully he will be moving out on his own one of these days. My husband and I had been talking about getting him some basic tools for when that time comes. This set is pretty comprehensive and contains most everything he would need. My husband was especially impressed with the drill. He has a similar one that he uses. The set includes a hammer, level, pliers, wrench, screw driver, all kinds of drill bits and more. The quality of some of the tools is just average, but more than adequate for the beginner. Everything fits in the canvas tote, but there are no compartments or pockets inside, so you are unable to organize it. We talked about getting him a tool box of some sort so the pieces can be organized and easier to find. With the bag, you pretty much have to take everything out to find what you're looking for! Overall, this is really a great set.

title: Soft Face Masks
text: My husband and son  have decided that they prefer this type of face mask whereas my daughter and I like the cloth ones better. These are well made and comparable to other ones we have seen. They are soft and comfortable. They have the all important (at least to my guys) nose bridge piece that can be shaped to provide a better fit.

title: Great for Wearing with Glasses!
text: We're living in a strange time with the current pandemic. I never thought I would be ordering face masks as often as I am. These are good quality disposable ones. They have the bendable wire at the bridge of the nose. That works well when wearing glasses. They are pleated so they fan out over different face sizes. They are light weight and comfortable to wear.

title: Great!
text: My 22 year old son recently asked me for a headlamp. I saw this pair and was happy to give it a try. My son has a large head, but it easily adjusted to fit him. It has a few different settings and can go from solid white to flashing white, as well as red lights. It uses a USB charger, which of course has its own pros and cons. As long as you keep it charged, it will be ready to go. If you are not good about that, then you it's possible it won't be ready when you need it. The only issue that my son has with it, his that the actual light doesn't angle as much as he would like. He's been wearing it for nighttime walks and for taking the garbage out after dark. This comes with 2 headlamps, so my husband volunteered to take the other one. He likes it, too!

title: Great Garage Storage
text: We have a wall of industrial shelving in our garage and one shelf has been devoted to storing the camping chairs. I was excited to get this and free up valuable shelf space. Installation was easy. Once installed, it's pretty secure to the wall. There are spaces to store four chairs (or other items if preferred). The straps can be adjusted depending on the sizes of the chairs. Our chairs are all heavy duty ones (rather than the cheaper, light weight ones) and the unit easily accommodates them. Of course, we have more than four chairs, so it didn't completely solve our storage issues, but it did help.

title: Pretty Cool!
text: I think this is a pretty cool gift to make. However, I felt overwhelmed by it. It comes mostly assembled, but you have to decorate it. I wish there was a guide book to give examples and suggestions on how to decorate it. It comes with some stickers, but they weren't really the kinds that I would use on a project like this. I felt that they were geared toward kids rather than adults. It does make a nice keepsake.

title: Sturdy Baggies!
text: I am trying to "go green" when I can. I found that I was throwing out some plastic baggies after using them that looked brand new. I would reuse them every once in a while, but because they were thin, they weren't really designed for multiple uses. I saw these and was excited to try them. I use them for fresh vegetables and fruits, packages of bacon and similar meats that are still in their original packing, but have been opened and aren't resealable. Because it doesn't recommend washing in hot water, I have not used them for raw meats such as beef, chicken or fish. It doesn't sound sanitary to me. I do wash them in very warm water with soap. These are very sturdy and durable. The zipper closure is okay, but it does require multiple attempts to fully seal them at times. This set comes with a variety of sizes. I'm still using disposable ones, but I'm using a lot less than I was before. Just in the last week, I've only used one disposable one. Baby steps!

title: Excellent Cutting Tool
text: My husband loves the Slice brand of ceramic cutting tools. This is his fourth one. They're safer to use than traditional cutting tools though I have cut myself on one before. However my husband assures me that it would have been a much deeper cut if it had been a metal one. This is easy to open and close, but not too easy that a young child would be able to figure it out right away. It's an excellent cutting tool.

title: Gorgeous Light!
text: This chandelier is gorgeous! It requires assembly and took my husband less than thirty minutes to put it together. We had planned to hang it in our entryway, but decided it was too small for our enormous two story space. It's a little larger than a basketball as far as size goes. I really didn't have any idea how it would fit in our space until seeing it in person. I'm not good at estimating size with just measurements. It is definitely better suited for a kitchen or smaller (one story) entry way. It has a modern yet rustic vibe to it. It's mostly metal, so it does have some weight to it. Now I am disappointed that I still have my ugly brass chandelier in my foyer!

title: Beautiful Faucet!
text: We have been replacing all of the original brass accessories in our daughter's bathroom with oil rubbed bronze items. This faucet is beautiful and looks very nice in the room. Installation was standard. The drain is not included, so we did have to buy that separately. The faucet functions as it should. It comes with the deck plate which we utilized since the faucet that was originally installed used three holes.  We are very pleased with it!

title: Nice Protection for Important Documents
text: We've kept our important documents in a safe, but it isn't fireproof. We had our items in a plastic accordion type folder. Now we keep our important papers and such in these pouches inside the safe. Zippers glide easily. Pouches are made nicely. There's room for our passports, marriage license, social security cards, birth certificates and more. These offer nice protection for important documents.

title: Works Nicely!
text: We have a shelf unit in our living room with our turntable and record collection. We've been in need of additional lighting there, so my husband installed this under the cabinet lighting there. Installation was pretty easy. It comes with what you need to position the lights. He had a little difficulties finding the right app for it because there were several apps with the exact name in the Google Play Store. While it works well through the app, it isn't working with our Google Home. My husband hasn't given up on that yet, so if he does get it to work, I will update my review. We do like that we can change the lighting color and brightness easily. It is much easier to search for records now!

title: Great Lighting!
text: I've wanted lighting for under my kitchen cabinets forever. This set of lights was easy to install. The most challenging part of it for my husband was peeling the double sided sticker paper off! Luckily, I was able to do that for him. It came with several different types of hanging mechanisms. We chose to use adhesive ones. We cleaned the surface off with rubbing alcohol first. The lights provide great lighting. I really like the dimmer feature. The new lighting makes a huge difference in the kitchen!

title: Durable!
text: This past fall, we said goodbye to our previous tarp. It had become torn and frayed. This tarp is much thicker and feels more durable. The grommets are securely attached. The whole thing feels pretty substantial. I don't think we're going to be having any troubles with this not holding up.

title: Great for Organizing!
text: I have a new book shelf in my living room that has a couple of drawers. My seat on the sofa is right next to it, so I've been storing pens, post-its, and other things that I use regularly in the drawer. It didn't take long before the drawer was a mess! Since adding these drawer organizers to it, it not only looks much better, but it's a lot easier to find things. They're sturdy and nice looking.

title: Good Basic Set
text: If you're like me, every time you want to paint a room, you need to get some basic supplies first. This set comes with everything you will need, except the paint, of course. It's a good, basic set. Some of the items are reusuable such as the paint can opener and the paint brush. Other things, such as the plastic sheet or blue painters tape are consumables and will need to be repurchased the next time. The quality seems to be mid-grade. It's not super cheap, but not the high end either.

title: Best Looking Toilet!!
text: This is the best looking toilet I have ever seen! The crown molding design is really nice and gives it a high end look. I like the squared design, too. The bolts that secure the toilet to the floor are hidden, which is a nice feature. Installation was pretty straight forward. It took a little time to do so, but it wasn't much different than installing other toilets. It's a little higher/taller than the previous toilet that we had. I didn't realize the other one was so short until we got this one. It is definitely the top of the line as far as toilets go.

title: Works Well With Google Home!
text: We have slowly been replacing our light bulbs with smart ones and adding smart plugs to our home. These are our first GE ones. When we installed them, we had to do a product update first thing. The light bulbs are nice. They work well with our Google Home.  We're pleased with them.

title: Great Replacement Blades!
text: These are great replacement blades! Since blades aren't ever lasting, it's good to have quality ones when you need to replace them. They work well in my husband's reciprocal saw. He recommends them.

title: Good Variety of Grits
text: This knife sharpening set comes with a good variety of grits to do the job. However, the handles aren't very sturdy and flex when sharpening more than I would like. The process of sharpening knives with them is okay, but not as easy as my old sharpener. They are pretty easy to store. Overall, they're okay.

title: Quality Drill Bits
text: My husband was happy to get this set of drill bits since they tend to wear out or become dull over time. These bits are sturdy and work well. My husband hasn't had to drill anything, so he played around with them and drilled through some wood and plastic to get a feel for them. He said they worked as expected. It is a nice variety of quality bits. The storage case is good and latches well. The inside of the case has a piece that allows you to stand the drill bits up while you are working to make it easier to remove them. My husband has been pleased with them so far.

title: Has Some Nice Features
text: An impact driver has been on my husband's wishlist for a while. It's the one tool that he felt that he actually needed. Most of his power tools are Ryobi brand and ideally he would have preferred a Ryobi impact driver mainly because of the shared battery option. However, he is a fan of the Bosch brand and highly respects them. This impact driver has some simple, but nice features. There's s light that comes on when you squeeze the trigger which can be helpful. Another feature that he likes is the belt clip. It can be put on the left or right side depending on which of your hands is dominant. There's also a lanyard so you can wear it around your neck which is added protection if your up on a ladder. The driver itself works well, as expected. We haven't noticed any issues with the battery life being short. Overall, my husband likes it. Now I need to come up with something else to get him for Christmas!

title: Solid!
text: This is a solid, heavy duty paper punch. It's very convenient to be able to punch through up to thirty sheets of paper. It requires a little effort to punch through a larger quantity, but it's not difficult. This makes a great addition to the home office!

title: Sturdy!
text: This is truly a heavy duty gadget. It's very sturdy. You can mount it in the garage if you want, but my husband wanted to be able to transport it easily, so he chose not to. It has three outlets. It's retractable. It's easy to use!

title: Heavy Duty!
text: First let me say this was much larger than I expected. It's huge! But it makes sense since it has 65 feet of extension cord. It comes with the hardware so you can attach it to a wall if you want. It's heavy duty and will stand up to some abuse. The retraction feature works well. You can plug in 3 different items to it. My husband thought it would be nice if there was a small light at the end where you plug things into so you can make sure items are plugged in all the way. Overall, we are pleased with it.

title: Good, Soft White Light
text: These light bulbs are great! They provide lots of good, soft white light. We've been slowly replacing all the light bulbs in the house with LED ones for energy efficiency. These work as expected and are comparable to the name brand ones we get at the hardware super store!

title: Wonderful Lights!
text: My daughter asked me to get her some Christmas lights for her dorm room. This one set will be more than enough for her room. It's one long strand that is equal to a few standard sets. There are multiple settings so you can have twinkle lights or flashing, etc. These are wonderful lights and will make her room quite festive!

title: Great Lamp!
text: We got this lamp for my daughter to take to college to go under her loft bed. It flexes enough that it can fit easily under there and offers adequate lighting while sitting on her bean bag chair. It looks much nicer than a lot of the floor lamps that we were looking at getting for her. It comes with an LED bulb.  Overall, we're very pleased with it.

title: Portable Sink!
text: What a useful item to take camping with you! For years when we would go camping, we would take a lot of disposable supplies such as plates, cups, plasticware. However, in more recent years, we've started making the switch to reusable items for environmental reasons. When taking items that need to be rinsed and washed, this is definitely handy. We were cleaning items at the water hookup site close to our campsites, but that can be wasteful. This sink allows more control over the amount of water you're using. It is collapsible and doesn't take up a lot of room when not being used. The sides are rigid enough to work as a sink, but it's not really designed for being transported when full of water. It's not really very deep or large and it works better for accommodating smaller items such as silverware, cups, and plates. Overall, I think it is a good portable sink!

title: Great!
text: My sister got one of these for her son a few years ago and I was fascinated by it. I think it's a great idea! It allows enough light so you can see what you're doing on those middle of the night trips to the bathroom. It gives enough light to do your business. It's easy to use and rotates through the various colors. It has to be positioned where you'll pass in front of it and trigger the light.

title: Great Set!
text: This multi-tool is just what my husband needed. He's been installing flooring in the house and used this tool to cut some t-molding that required a shallow cut. He also was able to cut under the door jambs to allow him to put the flooring underneath it. The tool comes with all kinds of attachments such as different cutting blades and sanding pads. There's an LED light on the front that makes it easy to see what you're doing. It comes with a battery and charger. The battery hasn't needed to be recharged yet since the initial charging and he's done quite a bit with it. It's a great addition to his tool box.

title: Cute!
text: These solar powered garden stakes are really cute. Some assembly is required. No tools needed. However, it took several attempts to get the flowers lined up properly. The pieces screw together and if you don't have them lined up correctly to start with , the flowers end up on the back side. I had to try nearly a dozen times to get one of them lined up satisfactorily. I also wish the mason jars didn't point in the same direction. Right now my husband has them set up one on each side of the front sidewalk near the steps. I'm probably going to relocate them because they look odd since they both face the same way. Other than that, I'm very pleased with these.

title: Backyard Fun!
text: These solar lights add some fun to the backyard! They are attractive, bead covered tinted orbs that light up at night. There are four in this set. They have an on/off button, but I just keep them on all the time. I've had to move them around a couple of times to make sure that they can get good sunlight during the day or else they don't work at night. I am considering ordering a few more to add to them.

title: Comes with Batteries
text: My husband is not a welder by trade, but he has done some welding with the marching band dads when building props and equipment. The band dads have one helmet among them. The ones not wearing the helmet look away when the welding is going on. My husband is glad to have his own helmet now for these times. First of all, it comes with batteries. You got to love it when it comes with everything you need so you can use it right out of the box. Secondly, it comes with  an extra tinted glass piece in case the original one gets scuffed up or damaged. The mask works as it should. My husband was able to demonstrate all the features to me. The glass automatically adjusts to the brightness of lights. It's easy to set the controls and use. Overall, he is very pleased with it.

title: Works Great!
text: This is my second Tubshroom! This one was installed in my son's bathroom. He has long, thick, curly hair. He isn't one to take baths, so the fact that it doesn't stop the water from draining isn't an issue. It was pretty easy to install and it works great! Now I need to get one for my bathroom sink!

title: Works Great!
text: My daughter has fairly long hair and sheds a lot in the shower. She had been using one of those hair catchers that you place over the drain for the past few years. This is so much nicer looking! You don't see the hair collecting, but it does. Then it just pops out so you can remove the hair. We did have to purchase a drain stopper since we had to remove that before installing, but that's okay. Overall, we're very pleased with this.

title: They Work!
text: Reviewing light bulbs is hard. They look like light bulbs. They fit my light sockets as they should. They provide light like they should. I can't say whether or not they last 10,000 hours because A) it hasn't been that long yet and B) I'm not keeping track of the hours. So far they are all doing what they should be doing.

title: Huge Time Saver!
text: This cordless blower is a huge time saver! My husband almost even enjoys using it! Before this arrived, it was an ordeal to blow leaves off the patio or deck. Moving from area to area was a pain! With this, he just puts on the battery and goes wherever the need is. He can do quick clean ups in a lot less time. It worked right out of the box, but the battery wasn't fully charged, so after a quick test, he removed the battery and waited until it was fully charged. It worked beautifully! Who would have thought something as simple as a cordless leaf blower would have brought so much happiness to our house!

title: Fun Garden Decor
text: When not in use, these aren't very attractive and look like cheap plastic flowers. However, when it's dark and they're lit up, they look magical! This fun garden decor really needs more than the two bunches you get to create any kind of landscape design. I like that they are solar powered, but because we've had a lot of rainy & cloudy weather, it took a while before they were able to get enough sunlight to operate. In the end, I think they are a fun addition to my backyard space.

title: As Expected
text: These 60 watt LED light bulbs, work as expected. They provide a nice, soft white light.

title: Excellent Quality!
text: Delta faucets are reliable in my opinion. You know what you're getting and what to expect from them. This set is an excellent quality. It was a great choice for updating one of our 1990's original bathrooms. Installation was pretty quick and as expected. I really like the addition of the drain catch! The set looks great and works as expected.

title: Bathroom Upgrade!
text: This faucet is excellent! It's solid and very sturdy. You can tell that it's a high quality faucet when you see it in person.  It's been a big upgrade in our guest bathroom. We had to get a deck plate to go with it, but that was expected. It was fairly standard to install. It works well.

title: Bright Light!
text: We put these around our landscaping in our back yard. They provide a bright light, or you can adjust it so it's not as bright. You do need to position the solar panel so it can get sunlight. We've had several consecutive gloomy/rainy days lately and they wouldn't light up at all after the first day or so. Today was sunny, so they're working fine this evening. I like that this set comes with 6 lights. One more set should be all we need in the back yard.

title: Does the Job!
text: When I ordered this, I thought I was getting the original Shroom that collects hair in the drain. However, this universal tub stopper does a good job at what it's supposed to do. We do have one sink that doesn't have it's stopper anymore. This fits well into it and keeps the water from draining. This would be perfect to take with you on European trips since a lot of the sinks there do not have stoppers. Although it wasn't what I was expecting, it is a good product.

title: Works Great!
text: We already have a Hive Hub, thermostat and a light bulb, so we were excited to add another bulb to the collection. It paired right away with our Hub and app. We primarily use our Hive items with our Google Home. We've been using this new bulb for a couple of weeks and have not had any problems with it. Works great!

title: Love the Lock, Problems with the App
text: The Yale lock was easy to install. The directions were easy to follow and everything with the installation worked as it should. The problems we have had are all with the app. My husband has tried it on his phone as well as mine. We both have Android phones. He's been in touch multiple times with the August customer support. They've sent him to the 2nd tier level of support. The problems he has been having are with the calibration. You are given a series of tasks such as open the door, unlock the door, lock the door, and so on. The app will then say it's unlocked, when it's not. I will say that the customer support reps that he has worked with have been pleasant and helpful. It's just that it's still not working. Luckily, we are able to use the Yale lock without the app by entering a pin on the key pad. If we do get it up and working properly, I will update my review.

title: We're Getting Closer to Having a Smart Home!
text: My husband and I like the idea of having a "smart home". After installing this, we are definitely getting closer! Our current house has 3 separate thermostats. We've already replaced 2 of the original ones with smart ones and this is our final one. Installation was easy enough, especially since we've done 2 others in the recent months. Of the 3, this is the coolest one and we wished we had save it for the main floor of the house. However, we did not, so it's in the master bedroom. The instructions were well written and easy to follow. We didn't have any problems setting it up with our Google Home assistant. It does require downloading an app in order to link it with the Google Home. Luckily I upgraded my phone recently and have double the storage since each of our new thermostats requires a different app!

title: Attractive Floor Lamp
text: This is an attractive floor lamp. It's a good height to illuminate down on you when sitting in a chair or to light the room. It does require some assembly. There's a base and three glass tubes that screw together to form the lamp post. It probably took my husband less than 5 minutes to put it all together. It is very sturdy and doesn't wobble at all. Then there's a linen like lamp shade to complete the look. It even comes with an LED light bulb. The only thing that I disliked was that it's packed in styrofoam which is messy to work with. Other than that, I really like this lamp and pleased with it.

title: User Friendly
text: We have a Google Home Assistant and have a few different smart outlets. This one is definitely one of the easiest to set up and link to the Google Home. The hub has to be set up first. We had not difficulties with that at all.We were able to access the hub via the website rather than installing an app, which we actually liked. I already have 3 different apps for the various smart outlets that we already have.  It also comes with the thermostat, an outlet, sensors and light bulbs. This is a great start up set if you haven't made the leap into the future. We've already decided that we need more light bulbs and outlet plugs to get it where we want it to be. Directions were well written and easy to follow. We plan to look at some of the other Hive items to add to our house!

title: Protects Floors and Keeps Furniture from Sliding!
text: I ordered these furniture pads to protect our new laminate flooring in the basement, but was pleasantly surprised to see how well they keep the furniture from sliding around the floors! The pads are pretty thick and have a very strong 3-M adhesive. The size and shape fit our basement sofas very well. We had to trim a few, but it was easy to cut. Our next project will be to put hardwoods in the living room. These pads are too small for the living room sofa, but I think we can just put 2 side by side for it. These are definitely better than the ones we found at the local hardware store and for the price you get a lot more!

title: Installation is Easy!
text: We've been gradually adding smart features to our home for use with our Google Home assistant. Prior to this we have only used smart plugs to control lamps. This has been our first wall switch. My husband is pretty handy. The TopGreener installation guide video that is located in the product link (with the photos) is excellent! If you weren't already knowledgeable with simple electrical work, it would be very helpful with installing this. The corresponding app is user friendly and everything works as it should. I am excited to be able to control more lighting with my Google Home!

title: Great Coverage
text: My guest bath is now the same color as Winnie the Pooh! The paint has great coverage and is a very good quality. The bathroom was a very pale blue before, but one coat was adequate in covering it. We used the paint with our Wagner Side Kick. Because the room was so small, it didn't take long to finish at all. We usually buy the cheapest paint at the store, but this higher quality paint is changing my mind about that. I have been very impressed with this.

title: Great Quality
text: My husband has been using a small, basic 8 inch level for as long as I can remember. He has been very pleased with this level. There's a small mirror inside the level that allows you to read it from different angles. That has been very useful. Another feature that he likes is that it has rubber ends to help protect it when dropped. It's sturdy and well made. It's a great addition to his tool collection.

title: Nice Looking Floor Lamp
text: I was so excited to replace my cheap plastic floor lamp with this one. It's a nice looking, classic lamp. There are two LED bulbs that can be pivoted into various directions. You turn on the lights by touching the the top of each shade. Each bulb has 3 levels of brightness. If you want it brighter, press the top again up to 3 times. The fourth time turns it off. It was really easy to put this lamp together. The only thing that I don't like about it, is that it won't work with my smart plug unit. I am very pleased with how this lamp looks in my living room.

title: Easy to Assemble
text: This lamp is easy to assemble. It even comes with a light bulb so you can use it right away. One thing that I especially like about it, is that the height of the lamp can be adjusted without too much difficulty. I originally had it extended to the maximum height, but then I moved it to a bedside table. There is a shelf above the bed next to the table and the lamp didn't fit there. With a quick adjustment, it fit perfectly. I don't like that the cord does not go through the base of the lamp to be hidden. It looks messy having it hang from the lamp like it does. Other than that, it's a decent lamp.

title: Easy to Install
text: This is an attractive looking ceiling fan. My husband followed the directions that were included. They were easy to understand, but in retrospect he felt that it made more sense to change a couple of the steps. He swapped out a ceiling light for the new fan, so the electric work had already been done.  He was able to do it all by himself until it was time to screw in the light fixture and then he needed me to hold it in place while he did that. One comment that he did have was that the fan pull and the light pull are at the same level. He said that often one will be located on the side slightly so you can tell them apart easily. There is no difference in where they are located on this unit. It's pretty quiet and offers a nice breeze. It came with an LED light bulb which was nice. Overall, he's very pleased with this addition to his work area.

title: Excellent Lighting!
text: We have been gradually replacing all of our light bulbs with LED ones over the past year or so. We're finally noticing a difference in our electric bill which makes it worth it. Plus, we're not having to replace the bulbs as frequently. These bulbs provide excellent daylight light. They are a little smaller than I expected, but they fit perfectly in our recessed kitchen lighting. These are definitely what you would expect from the Philips brand.

title: Great Lighting!
text: My husband has been gradually making the switch to LED lights. Whenever a bulb goes out, he swaps in an LED one. Most of the lights in our home are LED now. We put these in the master bathroom. First of all, I am very impressed with the amount of light they give. I didn't realize how dark it was in there before. It's so much easier to put on my make up now. We don't have dimmers in the bathroom, so we're not utilizing that feature. But they work fine in standard sockets. My husband has noticed a small decrease in our electric bill over the last year or so which he attributes to LED bulbs. These turn on instantly and are silent. They are what you would expect from the Philips product line.

title: Great Coverage!
text: I have used KILZ original spray primer before, but I was unfamiliar with their paint. It came with a paint stick, so it was just a matter of finding the time to do the actual painting. I decided that this color would look great in the master bathroom. The walls were already a light beige color, so one coat did the job. I love that it includes the primer.  The coverage is excellent. It took about 2/3rds of the bucket to cover the master bathroom. I used it with the Wagoner Powered Roller system. Clean up was easy enough and comparable to other paints that we have used. Overall, I am very pleased with the results.

title: Impressive Work Gloves
text: My husband wears work gloves for all kinds of projects, such as yard work, building marching band props, or home improvement. He has been very impressed with these gloves. He's 6'2" and weighs about 190 pounds. His hands are average sized. The large ones fit him well. They can be tightened at the wrist for a better fit. They allow plenty of movement, but still offer excellent protection. The quality is very good and so far they seem to be very well constructed.

title: Excellent Quality!
text: I was pleasantly surprised with the quality of these bathroom accessories. My daughter's bathroom has a mix of brass and stainless metal in her bathroom. We recently replaced her shower door with one accented with rubbed bronze, so we wanted to add more bronze items to her bathroom and eventually have everything replaced with the bronze. These items are heavier and more solid than the ones we took out of her bathroom. We used the existing brackets and such instead of replacing those as well. It didn't take my husband very long to change them out at all. The bases fit over the previous ones without leaving any trace of the former ones behind. I would definitely consider purchasing more bathroom accessories in this line.

title: Getting Closer to Having a Smart Home!
text: This smart Wi-Fi plug was a little difficult to get connected with our Google Home. Our router has both 2.4 ghz and 5 ghz capability and it worked fine with it. My husband downloaded the app on his phone and was able to control the Geeni plug through his phone without any problem. When he tried to set it up with Google Home, it wasn't recognized. He finally tried it on my phone and it worked. The only thing he could figure out was that I was the one who originally set up our Google Home using my phone. For whatever reason, it does work now as it should.

title: Looks Great!
text: I am so pleased with how this new lighting looks in my kitchen! We replaced a brushed nickel chandelier with this. It really warms the room up with the natural look. For the most part, it wasn't too difficult to install. The outer hanging wires were tangled and twisted a bit. My husband had to unscrew where they were attached at the top and pull them out to get them untwisted. Another slightly annoying issue we had was that since it was packed in styrofoam, there were lots of little styrofoam bits that were sticking to the shade. With the weather being so dry, they were statically charged and a pain to remove. Other than that, we really like our new lighting. The light is concentrated over the table. The LED light are warm. My husband is excited that he won't be having to change light bulbs!

title: Beautiful Shower Doors!
text: Our house was built in the late 90's and we've been gradually replacing those brass fixtures in the last 4 years since we have lived here. My daughter's bathroom had a not so lovely brass trimmed glass door set on her bath tub. My husband had replaced a shower door on a walk-in shower before, so he was somewhat familiar with the process. This ended up being a bigger job than he expected. This was wider than our opening, so we did have to use the saw to cut it to the right size. It also required my husband to drill 8 holes into the tile. Of course the holes from the brass door couldn't be used. There was one point when the directions were backwards when actually hanging the door. My husband did it the way it said in the instructions first, but had to remove the wheels and put them in the other direction. It took my husband most of the a day to install this by himself. He brought a TV and set it up outside the bathroom so he could follow the football playoffs. The finished doors look great! The materials are good quality. They do tend to slide on their own if not fully extended which means either the tub was not installed level or the house has settled enough that it's not level anymore. Now we need to replace the rest of the fixtures in the bathroom to finally be rid of the brass.

title: Comfortable Handle
text: The unique handle of this utility knife has taken a while for me to adjust to using. It's comfortable and easy to grip. There's a soft, rubber type portion on the handle nearest the blade which is extremely comfortable when gripping. The blade is sharp and cuts well. I appreciate that it comes with a protective guard because I keep my knives in a drawer. I especially love that the knife is dishwasher friendly. If I can't toss it in the dishwasher, it may not get washed.

title: Easy to Set Up
text:
I love the concept of a smart home and this is bringing us a little closer to that. My husband set it up and didn't have any major problems. It was having a difficult time getting it on our Wi-Fi at first. He called customer support and they were closed. Evidently their hours are pretty much 9-5 on M-F. Most working people are going to have difficulties with that. We panicked a little because connecting it to the Wi-Fi was one of the last steps. This was a chilly Saturday and we didn't have a working thermostat. One option my husband was considering was reinstalling our old one until he could find the time to call customer support, but that would involve another trip to the attic. He chose another option, which was pressing the reset button on the back of the thermostat and it restarted the process. That did it and it was able to connect this time.

My husband used the website to set up our daily schedules. My husband works at home a couple of days a week and we have a son in college who lives at home, too. Because of those factors, we couldn't use the app to enter our schedule. If you have a more simple schedule, you can do that on the app. It automatically changes from heating to cooling which our old thermostat didn't do.

It's a little smaller than our old thermostat. Because of this, I will be repainting my kitchen a lot sooner! It does look nice and the numbers are easy to read for my old eyes.

It doesn't work with Google Home yet, so we're hoping that will be added to it one of these days. But so far, we are very pleased with it.

title: Nice, Cool White Light
text: Over the past year or so, my husband and I have been replacing all of our light bulbs with LED ones. Gone are the days when you have to replace your bulbs regularly because they stop working. I love that they now last for years! We used to keep a bunch of extra light bulbs around. Now, all of the lamps and light fixtures that we have put LED bulbs in are still going strong. These bulbs are comparable to other LED bulbs we have used. They fit standard fixtures. They provide a lot of nice, cool white light. Plus, there's the bonus of LED bulbs costing less to operate and use less energy!

title: Cool Night Light
text: In my experience, most of the girly craft kits are about the crafting process and being creative, not the end product. This seems to hold true with the Fairy House Room Diffuser. Elementary school aged girls will enjoy decorating this with stickers. They will also think it's pretty cool night light. What we'll see is a plastic mushroom covered in stickers. They'll see a masterpiece. They will also love being able to diffuse their own oils in their bedrooms just like mom does. The bottle of oil that is included is really tiny. I have a mini-travel kit of oils that uses bottles that small. It's not going to last very long. It's probably best that it is small so the oil isn't misused by children. The diffuser is different from the ones that I have in my house. It still uses water, but it has a wick that diffuses the oil into the air. It isn't a continuous scent, but it does provide a slow, occasional lavender smell. It's not very strong, but it can be detected. Overall, I think it's cute and will be fun for the right audience.

title: Enough for the Whole Staircase!
text: My husband recently ripped up the carpet in our basement. He decided to remove the carpet on the stairs leading down to the basement as well. Unfortunately, the wood beneath the carpet was rough and splintery. I had a set of 7 tread mats that worked well on it, but that only covered half of the steps. I was excited to see that these were available in 14 mats! They look great. They do move just ever so slightly. About once a week I find that I am straightening them up a little.For the most part they stay in place. We've never had any issue with them moving more than a small amount while walking up or down the stairs.  I may try some carpet tape to see if that works even better. My cats were a little weary of the carpet mats at first, but they have adjusted it. I love the way they look and the fact that I don't have to worry about splinters from the stairs anymore. Eventually, my husband plans to replace the steps with a nice quality finished wood, but until then, they are working great!

title: They Stay in Place!
text: Recently my husband pulled up all the carpet in the basement, including the stairs. The wood under the stairs was rough and splintery. These have been a life saver! Each pieces covers about 2/3rd of a step. We centered them on each one. I am very impressed with how well they stay in place. I was expecting them to move around a bit. They are slightly padded and comfortable to walk on. Plus, they look better than the bare wood.

title: Attractive Lamp
text: This is an attractive lamp. It's got a contemporary, yet classic look to it. The size is a little smaller than I expected. It would be perfect for a nightstand or an end table that is not the primary light source for a room. We tried to find a way to open the base up so we could fill the glass with something, but we couldn't find a way to access it without removing the felt cover on the bottom of the base. It was easy to put together. It provides a decent amount of light.

title: Not an Easy Installation
text: I thought this would be an easy project. We had an existing water filtration system when we moved into our home a few years ago. We didn't use it because we didn't have any instructions or manual for it and didn't know if it was properly maintained by the previous owners. So when I saw this, I thought it would be a simple switch. It was not. We took out all the components of the old filtration system. This one is much larger. My husband was a little concerned that it would not fit at all, but he was able to get it in there. The instructions were okay, but there were a few instances where more details would have been nice such as when you put the hose in the bucket to catch leaking water during the process, but it didn't say which hose to put in the bucket. Reinstalling the spigot was pretty challenging and required a basin wrench.  Eventually it was all set up and time to test the water pressure when one of the hoses split. My husband called the company to get a new hose ordered. After almost two weeks, it hadn't shown up, so my husband called back. They had no record of the order, so they created a new order for the hose. It took nearly another two weeks before it finally arrived. Installation is finally complete. They system works well and we are pleased. The faucet looks great and is an improvement over the old stainless one that we previously had. We were happy that we didn't have to cut a hole in the granite counter since we already had a system.

title: Does The Job
text: It was a little difficult to get this into the 2 prong outlet, but with enough pressure, it finally went in. It does what it's supposed to do and I haven't had any issues with it.

title: Looks Great!
text: I've used several different brands of wall decals before, and this one was very similar to those. The directions were easy to follow and understand. It was a little tricky getting them all lined up as shown in the picture since the pieces are separate. It would have been much easier if it was all laid out as shown instead, but I guess that gives you the flexibility and freedom to change the layout if you desire. We didn't have any problems putting it on the wall. It did allow us to remove and readjust a few pieces that we weren't initially satisfied with because it looked a little crooked. In the end, we are pleased with how it turned out.

title: Fairly Good Protection
text: Sizing of these gloves is good and what was expected.  The Velcro wrist straps customize the fit and keep them securely in place. The gloves are comfortable and offer fairly good protection. My husband uses work gloves a lot when he's helping with the high school marching band. He's used them for building props, picking up garbage after a big event, loading equipment into the truck, and much more. They are average thickness and there are some tasks that a thicker glove would be better suited, but for general tasks, they are good.

title: They Don't Restrict Too Much
text: My husband is president of the school marching band boosters this year. Already, I have stepped up my volunteering game so I can spend time with him. Our program recently hosted a Drum Corp International event and we spent the day after cleaning the school campus. I didn't have any work gloves, so I borrowed a pair of my husband's. Now, I have my own! These are way better than his! First of all, I love the turquoise color. The leather palms are soft and pliable. I have fairly large hands and the size Large gloves fit snuggly without being tight or uncomfortable. We were moving some band equipment last night that was a bit dewy and the gloves kept my hands dry and the moisture repelled nicely. I was able to move my hand pretty easily and could do a lot while wearing them. I couldn't do things that required fine motor skills, but I really don't think any other gloves would have allowed me to do so either. I am keeping these in my car for the rest of band season. I love having the protection from splinters and such.

title: Sturdy & Beautiful Lights
text: These are beautiful cafe' lights. I have a set of traditional glass bulb cafe lights, but these are much more durable.  They both have a thick and sturdy "string". It's really more of a cable than a string wire. The bulbs are tough and very sturdy. They give a bright, warm white light which nicely decorates and illuminates our patio very well. The bulbs do look different than the glass ones.  They are clear, solid bulbs. The pictures are very accurate. There are small holes/openings on the cable which allowed my husband to hang the strand on to nails on our deck. These are much better suited to the outdoors because of their durability. Overall, I am very impressed with them.

title: Nice, Bright White Light
text: This LED lighting has made a huge difference in my laundry room. The lighting in the room wasn't very good. Whenever I stain treated an article of clothing, I always had to take it out into the kitchen for better lighting to see if the stain was gone or not. With this new light, I don't have to leave the laundry room. There's so much light, I can easily check for the stains in there. The fixture is about twice as long as what was in there beforehand. It was very easy for my husband to install. It came with a connector piece, but that didn't fit, so my husband had to use something else that he had on hand. He said that wasn't really a big deal. The whole thing took about fifteen minutes tops. Instructions were easy to follow.  We've been gradually replacing all of our old bulbs with LED ones. This fixture gives off a bright, white light.

title: Love the Cool White Light!
text: A few years ago, my husband started replacing all of our light bulbs with fluorescent bulbs to save money and energy. Then last year, LED bulbs were more readily available and becoming affordable, so he has started replacing them with LED ones. They use even less wattage and at this price, I can afford to replace all of the remaining bulbs in the house! I wasn't sure what to think of them having plastic bulbs, but I really do like that they are safer to handle and they are made with less materials. I think we must have been using warm light bulbs, because these have made a huge difference in our lighting so far in the rooms we've installed them. The difference in my bathroom lighting is huge! We have a light fixture above the mirrors that holds six bulbs and we've replaced all of them with these new ones.  It's so much brighter and looks a lot more like natural lighting now.  It's easier to apply my make up with the better lighting. We are very pleased!

title: Great for All Kinds of Cutting
text: I have used many Fiskars scissors in my crafting, so I am familiar with the brand. I associate Fiskars with quality scissors and these do not disappoint. My husband has found them to be excellent in cutting through all kinds of materials. He has been tearing up the basement carpet. Then he was using a box cutter to cut it into smaller pieces for disposal. These scissors made the job much easier, plus I didn't worry about him accidently cutting his hand with the box cutter. These are heavy duty and high quality. My husband is very pleased with these and glad to have them in his workshop.

title: Gives a Lot of Light!
text: My husband started replacing all of our light bulbs with LED ones a couple of years ago. It has really made a difference in our electric bill. These bulbs are equivalent to 100 Watt bulbs, so they give off a lot of light. We don't have overhead lighting in our great room, so we have a floor lamp and a couple of table lamps in there. Plus, we have four long windows for some natural light. The floor lamp is behind my recliner and I am very pleased with the amount of light it puts out now with these LED bulbs. These bulbs are a little larger than the smaller wattage ones that my husband took out of the lamp so I could put these in it. These are definitely comparable to other LED bulbs that we have purchased at the local hardware store. And the price is about the same, too.

title: Nice Features!
text: My husband enjoys DIY projects. In our old house, he installed hardwood flooring just about everywhere and purchased a Bostitch nail gun (that required a compressor) for that job. He was excited to try a cordless nail gun for upcoming projects in our new house. The Hitachi unit is definitely heavier since it requires battery power, but he was still able to use it one handed without any difficulties. There's an option to set continuous mode where it allows you to repeat without pushing the trigger each time. There are two safety features. First of all, there's a power on/off switch so you can't accidently set it off when not in use. It also has a safety lock, which his Bostitch did not have. He loves the little light that shines where you're aiming! He's decided that all power tools need to have that feature. There's a low battery life light so you know when you need to recharge the unit. It has a clip so you can hang it on your tool belt. It's a little quieter than the old nail gun since you don't have to use an air compressor. It doesn't come with any nails, so I had to run up to the hardware store to find some. There were plenty of options at the store and I was able to buy a small box for $12 so he could play around with it until we are ready for the next big home improvement job. It's a nice, high quality tool and my husband is very happy with it.

title: Sturdy Hook!
text: This is a simple, basic over the door hook. The stainless steel material goes with all kinds of decor. It easily hangs over the door with an almost perfect fit. This looks much better than the plastic over the door hook I had in my bathroom. The hook is sturdy and supports the weight of a heavy robe or damp bath towel. There's a hole in the top where it looks like you could add a screw for extra support, but I haven't found that to be necessary.

title: Sturdier Than Our Other Ratchet Tie Downs!
text: We have a smaller set of ratchet tie downs that we bought at the local hardware store, but this set is a little bigger and has a greater weight capacity. They are also much thicker and wider, as well as heavy duty and very sturdy. They work just as ratchet ties are supposed to without any problems. One noticeable difference between these and the basic ones that we already have are the handles with grips. My husband was very pleased with that feature. His other ones have just an uncovered piece of metal which is not very comfortable to hold on to when adjusting the straps. There is also rubber covering on the release handle which makes it easier when releasing the straps.

title: High Quality Tools
text: The Irwin Tools Metric Nut Driver set is a high quality addition to any tool collection. First, I must mention that it was a little difficult to open and remove the drivers from the plastic. Once they were out, you can immediately tell that they are well made and heavy duty. The handles have a very comfortable grip and fit nicely in your hand. The sizes are well labeled which is extremely helpful when looking for the correct driver for the job. This set is a replacement for my husband's nut driver that has replaceable heads. I'm happy that I won't find any more loose heads in the dryer because he left them in his pants' pocket! This is my husband's first Irwin product. He was familiar with the brand, but had never owned anything by them before. He is very pleased with the quality and will consider purchasing other Irwin tools in the future.

title: Better Than Expected
text: This has ended up surpassing my expectations. It's easy to use and set up. Instructions are clear and easy to follow, but the timer itself is user friendly and didn't require lots of rereading of the instructions in order to get it working. This is so much better than the basic, simple timer that we have that basically just turns the sprinkler on and off. It has a large, LCD display. This is going to be great when we are on vacation this summer. Our vegetable garden is usually neglected during summer vacations. We have not had any issues with leaking. There are several different timing options available which makes it very helpful.

title: Cute Size!
text: I ordered this so I could make my own travel case of essential oils. This little case is really cute and fits 10 small bottles of oils. I think my bottles were 2 ml sized. They fit snugly in the elastic compartments and are protected well. I probably won't be keeping this on my key chain, but with the clip I can attach it to my tote bag so it's easy to get to.
